definition_zh: 突变；变异；（一般意义上的）变化；语音换音
definition_en: a change in genetic material, the process that produces such a change, or a change of form in a broader sense
core_image: 复制过程中一个字母被换掉，整段指令的意思随之改变，纸带上留下一个明显的错位
scene: 复制过程中一个字母被换掉，整段指令的意思随之改变。 A single mutation can switch off a gene that controls cell division.
sceneCN: 这里 mutation 指「遗传物质中的一个改变」（第 1 个义项：基因序列的变化）；句意为一个突变就能关闭控制细胞分裂的基因。可辨识物件：复制纸带、错位字母、红色标记、基因示意图。

senses.title: A change in genetic material
senses.definition: an alteration in the sequence or structure of genetic material
senses.definitionCN: 遗传物质序列或结构的改变
senses.example: A mutation in the control region increased the plant's height.
senses.exampleCN: 控制区的一个突变增加了这株植物的高度。
senses.why: The technical sense is a change at the level of instructions, which is why it can be small in size and large in effect.
senses.whyCN: 技术义指指令层面的改变，因此它可以很小，却产生很大影响。

senses.title: The process that produces variation
senses.definition: the process by which genetic changes arise and supply variation
senses.definitionCN: 遗传改变产生并提供变异的过程
senses.example: Mutation supplies the variation on which selection acts.
senses.exampleCN: 突变为自然选择提供作用其上的变异。
senses.why: As a process, mutation is a source rather than an event, so it appears without an article in population genetics.
senses.whyCN: 作为过程，突变是来源而非事件，因此在群体遗传学中常不带冠词。

senses.title: An organism carrying a change
senses.definition: an organism or strain that carries an altered genetic sequence
senses.definitionCN: 携带改变后遗传序列的生物体或品系
senses.example: The lab keeps a pale-eyed mutation in its fly stocks.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室在果蝇品系中保存着一个浅色眼的突变体。
senses.why: Laboratory usage shortens 'a mutant organism' to 'a mutation', especially when the change is the point of interest.
senses.whyCN: 实验室用法把「突变体生物」缩短为「一个突变」，尤其当改变本身是研究重点时。

senses.title: A general change of form
senses.titleCN: 一般意义上的变化、转变
senses.definition: a change in form, character or policy
senses.definitionCN: 形态、性质或政策上的变化
senses.example: The policy underwent several mutations before adoption.
senses.exampleCN: 这项政策在通过前经历了几次变化。
senses.why: The older general sense survives outside biology, where mutation means transformation rather than sequence change.
senses.whyCN: 较旧的一般义在生物学之外存续，那里的 mutation 指转变，而非序列改变。

senses.title: Vowel mutation in linguistics
senses.definition: a change in a vowel caused by a following sound, as in umlaut
senses.definitionCN: 由后接音引起的元音变化，如日耳曼语变音
senses.example: The plural shows mutation of the root vowel.
senses.exampleCN: 复数形式显示出词根元音的换音。
senses.why: Nineteenth-century philology used mutation for sound change, a sense older than the genetic one.
senses.whyCN: 19 世纪语文学用 mutation 指语音变化，这一义比遗传义更早。

senses.title: Mutation rate
senses.definition: the frequency with which genetic changes arise per generation or unit of time
senses.definitionCN: 每代或每单位时间出现遗传改变的频率
senses.example: Mutation rate depends on repair efficiency.
senses.exampleCN: 突变率取决于修复效率。
senses.why: Measuring changes turns them into a rate, which is why mutation appears in quantitative genetics as a number.
senses.whyCN: 测量改变使其成为比率，因此在数量遗传学中 mutation 以一个数字出现。

senses.title: Mutation breeding
senses.definition: the use of induced genetic changes to produce new varieties
senses.definitionCN: 利用诱发的遗传改变产生新品种
senses.example: Mutation breeding produced a shorter rice variety.
senses.exampleCN: 突变育种产生了一种更矮的水稻品种。
senses.why: Breeding treats mutation as a tool: changes are induced, then selected, without inserting foreign sequences.
senses.whyCN: 育种把突变当作工具：诱发改变后再选择，不插入外来序列。

senses.title: Neutral, harmful or beneficial
senses.titleCN: 中性、有害或有利的突变
senses.definition: a genetic change classified by its effect on the organism
senses.definitionCN: 按对生物体的影响分类的遗传改变
senses.example: Most mutations are neutral, a few are harmful, and a very few help.
senses.exampleCN: 多数突变是中性的，少数有害，极少数有利。
senses.why: The word does not build harm into its meaning; effects are added by the adjectives that surround it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本身不含「有害」，影响是由周围的形容词加上的。

intro.en: Mutation comes from Latin mutatio 'a change', from mutare 'to change'. English used it for general change before genetics gave it a technical sense.
intro.cn: mutation 来自拉丁 mutatio「变化」，源自动词 mutare「改变」。在遗传学赋予它技术义之前，英语已用它表示一般变化。

items.en: Mutare 'to change' is the base of mutatio. Its deeper origin is not established beyond Latin, so any pre-Latin root is a reconstruction.
items.cn: mutare「改变」是 mutatio 的基础。它在拉丁语之外的更深来源未得到确证，因此任何拉丁语之前的词根均属重构。

items.en: Mutatio 'a change' was formed with -tio, the action-noun suffix, from the past participle stem mutat-.
items.cn: mutatio「变化」由过去分词词干 mutat- 加动作名词后缀 -tio 构成。

items.en: Mutation entered English in the fourteenth century with the general sense 'change, alteration'; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: mutation 在 14 世纪以「变化、改动」的一般义进入英语；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Late nineteenth- and early twentieth-century genetics gave mutation the technical sense of a change in hereditary material; the genetic sense is recorded from 1894.
items.cn: 19 世纪末至 20 世纪初的遗传学赋予 mutation「遗传物质改变」的技术义；遗传义从 1894 年起有记录。

items.en: Nineteenth-century philology used mutation for vowel change, especially umlaut; the term i-mutation is recorded from 1874.
items.cn: 19 世纪语文学用 mutation 指元音变化，尤其是变音；i-mutation 这一术语从 1874 年起有记录。

items.en: Source uncertain (pre-Latin origin and sense dates): mutare has no established deeper etymology, and the boundary between general and biological use is not sharply dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（拉丁语之前词源与义项年代）：mutare 没有已确立的更深词源，一般义与生物学义的分界也没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one separates mutation from its family and from a dangerous look-alike; group two separates it from words for variation and change.
note.cn: 第一组把 mutation 与其词族及一个易混形近词分开；第二组把它与「变异」「变化」类词区分。

entries.definition: The verb meaning 'to undergo or cause a mutation'; mutation is the event or process.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「发生或导致突变」的动词；mutation 是事件或过程。

entries.definition: An organism carrying a mutation, or the adjective describing it; it is a noun of the changed body.
entries.definitionCN: 携带突变的生物体，或描述它的形容词；指被改变的身体。

entries.definition: Relating to a mutation; the adjective does not name the change itself.
entries.definitionCN: 与突变相关的；形容词不命名改变本身。

entries.definition: From mutilare 'to maim, cut off', not mutare: the act of damaging or removing a part. The resemblance is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 mutilare「残害、割去」，并非 mutare：指损伤或割除某一部分。相似是偶然的。

entries.definition: Difference among individuals; mutation is one source of variation, not variation itself.
entries.definitionCN: 群体内个体间的差异；突变是变异的来源之一，并非变异本身。

entries.definition: A change in something, often deliberate; mutation stresses a change in form or sequence.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的改变，常为有意；mutation 强调形态或序列的改变。

entries.definition: The broad everyday word; mutation is narrower and often technical.
entries.definitionCN: 宽泛的日常用词；mutation 更窄，常带技术性。

entries.definition: A complete change of form, often dramatic; mutation can be a single small change.
entries.definitionCN: 形态的彻底改变，常较剧烈；mutation 可以是单个微小改变。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: mutare 'to change' + -tion: the act of changing.
normal.cn: mutare「改变」+ -tion：改变的行为。

normal.en: The family runs mutate, mutation, mutant and mutational.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 mutate、mutation、mutant 与 mutational。

normal.en: Mutation rate, point mutation and mutation breeding are fixed phrases.
normal.cn: 突变率、点突变与突变育种是固定搭配。

normal.en: Mutation is not automatically harmful: most changes are neutral.
normal.cn: 突变并非自动有害：多数改变是中性的。

normal.en: Linguistic mutation means vowel change, an older sense.
normal.cn: 语言学中的 mutation 指元音换音，是更早的义项。

abstract.en: Picture a single wrong letter turning a recipe into a different dish.
abstract.cn: 想象一个错字母把食谱变成另一道菜。

abstract.en: Picture a copying machine that occasionally drops a mark.
abstract.cn: 想象一台复印机偶尔漏掉一个记号。

abstract.en: Picture a rumour changing as it passes from mouth to mouth.
abstract.cn: 想象一个传闻在口耳相传中改变。

examples.en: The mutation was traced to a single base change.
examples.cn: 这个突变被追溯到单个碱基改变。

examples.en: Mutation is the raw material of evolution.
examples.cn: 突变是进化的原料。

examples.en: The old word underwent a mutation in meaning over two centuries.
examples.cn: 这个旧词在两个世纪里经历了词义变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: mut（改变）+ ation（名词尾）——改变的结果 → 突变；一般义是「变化」。

root: 拉丁 mutatio「变化」← mutare「改变」；mutare 在拉丁语之外的更深来源不确定，相关原始印欧语词根均属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one changed unit: the change itself, the process, the carrier, a general alteration, a vowel shift, a rate, a breeding tool and a classification by effect.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个被改变的单位展开：改变本身、过程、携带者、一般变化、元音换音、比率、育种工具与按效果分类。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one letter replaced during copying, and the meaning of the whole strip shifts.
core.cn: 核心意象：复制时一个字母被替换，整条纸带的意思随之改变。

branches.en: CHANGE AND SOURCE: a change in the material, and the process that keeps supplying it.
branches.cn: 改变与来源：物质中的改变，以及不断提供改变的过程。

branches.en: CARRIER AND EFFECT: an organism that carries the change, and how its effect is classified.
branches.cn: 携带者与效果：携带改变的生物体，以及效果如何分类。

branches.en: GENERAL CHANGE: policy and form can mutate outside biology.
branches.cn: 一般变化：政策与形态在生物学之外也能改变。

branches.en: VOWEL CHANGE: philology used the word for sound shift before genetics did.
branches.cn: 元音变化：语文学在遗传学之前就用这个词指语音转变。

branches.en: MEASURE AND TOOL: a rate to count, and a breeding method to use.
branches.cn: 度量与工具：可计数的比率，以及可使用的育种方法。

intro.en: Mutation is a Latin action noun; its stem also builds the verb, the carrier noun and the adjective, and the same root appears in words for change and unchangeability.
intro.cn: mutation 是拉丁动作名词；其词干还构成动词、携带者名词与形容词，同一词根也出现在表示「可变」与「不可变」的词中。

latinIntro.en: Latin mutare gives mutate, mutation, mutant and mutable; com- and in- build commutation and immutable, trans- builds transmutation. All belong to the same changing root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 mutare 衍生 mutate、mutation、mutant 与 mutable；com- 与 in- 构成 commutation 与 immutable，trans- 构成 transmutation。它们都属同一「改变」词根。

items.example: The root names the act of changing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根命名改变的动作。

items.example: Mutatio is the direct source of mutation.
items.exampleCN: mutatio 是 mutation 的直接来源。

items.example: The suffix makes an action noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成动作名词。

items.example: A mutation can be neutral.
Viruses mutate quickly.
The mutant lacked wings.
Mutational load was measured.
The sequence is mutable.
The rule is immutable.
Commutation of a sentence reduced the penalty.
The transmutation of elements was once alchemy.
items.exampleCN: 元素转变曾属于炼金术。

latinEntries.structure: muto, mutare, mutavi, mutatum (verb, first conjugation)

definition_zh: 精炼；改良；精细化；优雅；提纯
definition_en: the act of making something more precise, polished or pure, or the quality of being polished
core_image: 一块粗铁矿在炉中反复熔炼，表面逐渐变得光洁
scene: 这里指「精炼」。 Repeated refinement of the model reduced its error from ten percent to two.
sceneCN: 这里 refinement 指「逐步精细化」（第 1 个义项：通过反复调整使结果更精确）；句意：对模型的反复精细化把误差从百分之十降到百分之二。图中可辨识物件：模型曲线、误差刻度、迭代箭头、砂纸。

pos.zh: 精炼；改良；精细化；优雅；提纯；（复数）细微改进

senses.title: Making more precise
senses.titleCN: 精细化：通过反复调整使更精确
senses.definition: the act of improving something by small repeated changes that make it more exact
senses.definitionCN: 通过反复的小改动使某物更精确的行为
senses.example: Repeated refinement of the model cut its error from ten percent to two.
senses.exampleCN: 对模型的反复精细化把误差从百分之十降到百分之二。
senses.why: The noun comes from refine, which joins re- 'again' to finire 'to make fine or end'; refinement is the process of making something finer step by step.
senses.whyCN: 该名词出自 refine，后者把 re-「再次」与 finire「使精细、结束」结合；refinement 就是一步步使事物更精细的过程。

senses.title: Elegance of manner
senses.titleCN: 举止优雅：教养与分寸感
senses.definition: the quality of polished, cultivated behaviour or appearance
senses.definitionCN: 经过打磨的、有教养的举止或外表的品质
senses.example: Her refinement showed in the way she listened without interrupting.
senses.exampleCN: 她的教养体现在她听人说话从不打断。
senses.why: The physical sense of removing coarse material became social: a person can be 'fined' by education until roughness is gone.
senses.whyCN: 去除粗料的物理义转向社会领域：人可以经教育「被精炼」，直到粗粝消失。

senses.title: Purification of a substance
senses.titleCN: 提纯：把原料中的杂质去除
senses.definition: the industrial process of removing impurities from sugar, oil, metal or another raw material
senses.definitionCN: 从糖、油、金属或其他原料中去除杂质的工业过程
senses.example: Sugar refinement removes molasses and leaves white crystals.
senses.exampleCN: 制糖提纯去除糖蜜，留下白色结晶。
senses.why: This sense is the most literal: the substance is made fine by taking away what is coarse or unwanted.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项最字面：通过去掉粗劣或不需要的成分，使物质变精细。

senses.title: Technical iteration
senses.titleCN: 技术迭代：网格或算法逐步加密
senses.definition: in computing and engineering, a repeated tightening of a mesh, model or estimate until it meets a tolerance
senses.definitionCN: 在计算与工程中，对网格、模型或估计反复加密，直到满足容差
senses.example: Mesh refinement near the wing tip improved the simulation.
senses.exampleCN: 翼尖附近的网格加密改善了模拟结果。
senses.why: Numerical work speaks of refinement when the grid is made finer; the word keeps its literal sense of reducing coarseness.
senses.whyCN: 数值工作把网格变细称为 refinement；该词保留了「减少粗糙度」的字面义。

senses.title: Improving a theory
senses.titleCN: 理论完善：补足漏洞与例外
senses.definition: the act of revising a theory or explanation to account for more cases and fewer errors
senses.definitionCN: 修订理论或解释，使其覆盖更多情形、减少错误的行为
senses.example: The refinement of the theory followed years of contrary evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 这一理论的完善是在多年反证之后才实现的。
senses.why: A theory is treated like a raw material: each revision removes a defect, and the result is a finer version of the same thing.
senses.whyCN: 理论被当成原料：每次修订去掉一个缺陷，结果是同一事物的更精细版本。

senses.title: Social polish
senses.titleCN: 社交修养：礼节上的打磨
senses.definition: training in etiquette and courteous habits, often associated with a particular social class
senses.definitionCN: 在礼节与礼貌习惯上的训练，常与特定社会阶层相关
senses.example: The finishing school promised to teach refinement and poise.
senses.exampleCN: 这所精修学校承诺教授社交修养与仪态。
senses.why: Social class turned polish into a marker: refinement became something one could acquire and display.
senses.whyCN: 社会阶层把「打磨」变成标记：修养成了可以习得并展示的东西。

senses.title: Discriminating taste
senses.titleCN: 鉴赏力：能分辨细微差别
senses.definition: the ability to notice small differences in quality, especially in art, food or music
senses.definitionCN: 察觉质量细微差别的能力，尤指在艺术、饮食或音乐方面
senses.example: Her refinement of taste let her spot the counterfeit at once.
senses.exampleCN: 她的鉴赏力让她立刻看出赝品。
senses.why: A refined instrument detects fine distinctions; applied to taste, refinement names the same sensitivity.
senses.whyCN: 精密的仪器能察觉细微差别；用于品味时，refinement 命名的正是这种敏感度。

senses.title: Adding distinctions
senses.titleCN: 细化区分：在定义中补入更细的差别
senses.definition: in logic and writing, the addition of distinctions that make a statement more exact
senses.definitionCN: 在逻辑与写作中，补入使陈述更精确的区分
senses.example: The final refinement distinguished two senses that had been conflated.
senses.exampleCN: 最后的细化区分了此前被混为一谈的两个义项。
senses.why: Here finis 'boundary' surfaces: refinement draws finer boundaries, separating what had been one blurry category.
senses.whyCN: 这里 finis「边界」浮现出来：refinement 画出更细的边界，把原先模糊的一类分开。

intro.en: Refinement is the noun of refine, an English verb built from re- 'again' and the Latin-derived root finire 'to bound, make fine'. It is not borrowed whole from Latin.
intro.cn: refinement 是 refine 的名词，而 refine 是由 re-「再次」与拉丁来源词根 finire「划定边界、使精细」构成的英语动词，并非整体借自拉丁。

items.en: Latin finis meant 'end, boundary, limit'. It produced finire 'to bound, limit', and the adjective finus or finitus 'fine, finished'.
items.cn: 拉丁 finis 意为「终点、边界、限度」，由此产生 finire「划定界限、限制」以及形容词 finitus「精细的、完成的」。

items.en: Old French refiner meant 'to purify, make fine', especially for sugar and metal. The re- here intensifies or repeats the making-fine.
items.cn: 古法语 refiner 意为「提纯、使精细」，尤用于糖与金属；其中的 re- 加强或重复「使精细」的动作。

items.en: English refine appears in the sixteenth century with the sense 'to purify a substance', then extends to language, manners and ideas.
items.cn: 英语动词 refine 于 16 世纪出现，意为「提纯物质」，随后扩展到语言、举止与观念。

items.en: Refinement follows refine + -ment, the noun suffix from Latin -mentum, naming the act or its result.
items.cn: refinement 由 refine 加 -ment 构成，后者出自拉丁 -mentum，命名动作或其结果。

items.en: By the seventeenth century refinement also named cultivated manners, and later fastidious taste.
items.cn: 到 17 世纪，refinement 也指有教养的举止，后来又指挑剔的品味。

items.en: The exact first English date is uncertain, and whether the social sense entered directly from French usage is not established.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代与语义传入路径）：英语首见确切年代存疑；社会义是否直接由法语用法传入，尚无定论。

note.en: The first group separates the refine family; the second gives near-synonyms for improvement, purity or elegance.
note.cn: 第一组区分 refine 词族；第二组给出关于改良、纯净或优雅的近义词。

entries.definition: To purify or make more exact. Refinement is the process or a single improvement.
entries.definitionCN: 指提纯或使更精确；refinement 是过程或一次改进。

entries.definition: Describing a purified substance or a cultivated person. It describes the result, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 形容提纯的物质或有教养的人；描述结果，而非动作。

entries.definition: A plant where oil or sugar is refined. It is a building, not the process.
entries.definitionCN: 指炼油或制糖的工厂；是建筑，不是过程。

entries.definition: A person or machine that refines. It names the doer, while refinement names the doing.
entries.definitionCN: 指进行精炼的人或机器；命名施动者，而 refinement 命名动作。

entries.definition: Any change for the better. Refinement usually implies small, repeated, precision-oriented changes.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何变好的改变；refinement 通常暗示细小、反复、以精确为目标的改动。

entries.definition: The removal of contaminants. It overlaps sense 3 but says nothing about elegance or precision.
entries.definitionCN: 指去除污染物；与第 3 个义项重叠，但不涉及优雅或精确。

entries.definition: A smooth surface, or a final tidy-up. It stresses the visible finish more than structural precision.
entries.definitionCN: 指光滑表面或最后的整理；更强调可见的完成度，而非结构精确。

entries.definition: Grace and stylish simplicity. It is close to sense 2 but focuses on beauty rather than training.
entries.definitionCN: 指形式上的优雅与简洁；接近第 2 个义项，但侧重美感而非训练。

entries.definition: A small, delicate difference or quality. It matches sense 7 but does not imply prior coarseness.
entries.definitionCN: 指细微而精巧的差别或品质；与第 7 个义项相合，但不暗示原先粗劣。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- 'again' + finire 'make fine' + -ment: being made fine again and again.
normal.cn: re-「再次」+ finire「使精细」+ -ment：被一次又一次做细。

normal.en: The family runs refine, refined, refiner, refinery, unrefined.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 refine、refined、refiner、refinery、unrefined。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: model refinement, sugar refinement, refinement of taste, further refinement.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：模型细化、制糖提纯、品味修养、进一步细化。

normal.en: finis means boundary, so refinement draws finer lines between things.
normal.cn: finis 意为边界，因此 refinement 在事物之间画出更细的线。

normal.en: A refinery is the place; refinement is the process.
normal.cn: refinery 是场所，refinement 是过程。

abstract.en: Picture ore going through furnace after furnace until the surface turns bright.
abstract.cn: 想象矿石经过一座又一座炉子，直到表面变亮。

abstract.en: Picture a blurred line redrawn with a sharper pencil until two edges appear.
abstract.cn: 想象一条模糊的线被更尖的铅笔重画，直到显出两条边。

abstract.en: Picture a hand smoothing rough paper until the fingertips feel no grain.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把粗纸磨平，直到指尖摸不到纹理。

examples.en: The refinement of the telescope design took several prototypes.
examples.cn: 望远镜设计的改进用了几台原型机。

examples.en: Refinement of the raw sugar takes place at a mill near the coast.
examples.cn: 原糖的提纯在海岸附近的一家糖厂进行。

examples.en: Her refinement was evident in small courtesies, not in display.
examples.cn: 她的修养体现在细小的礼貌，而非炫耀。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）+ fine（精细）」——一遍遍做到更细 → refinement 精炼、精细化

root: 拉丁 finis「边界、终点」→ finire「划定界限、使精细」→ 古法语 refiner「提纯」→ 英语 refine + -ment。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses refine different materials: a model, a manner, a substance, a mesh, a theory, a social style, a taste, and a definition.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项精炼的对象各不相同：模型、举止、物质、网格、理论、社交风格、品味与定义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ore passing through furnace after furnace until the surface shines.
core.cn: 核心意象：矿石经过一座座炉子，直到表面发亮。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND PROCESS: coarse matter or an imprecise result is made fine.
branches.cn: 材料与过程：粗料或不精确的结果被做细。

branches.en: SOCIAL SURFACE: roughness is removed from behaviour, and polish becomes a class marker.
branches.cn: 社交表面：举止的粗粝被去除，打磨成为阶层标记。

branches.en: NUMERICAL GRID: the mesh is made finer until the tolerance is met.
branches.cn: 数值网格：网格被加密，直到满足容差。

branches.en: THEORY: revisions remove defects from an explanation.
branches.cn: 理论：修订为解释去除缺陷。

branches.en: PERCEPTION AND DEFINITION: finer distinctions are heard, seen, or written into a statement.
branches.cn: 感知与定义：更细的差别被听见、看见，或被写进陈述。

intro.en: Refinement is an English noun of action: a Latin root for boundary and fineness, a French-influenced verb, and the noun suffix -ment.
intro.cn: refinement 是英语动作名词：一个表示边界与精细的拉丁词根，一个受法语影响的动词，以及名词后缀 -ment。

latinIntro.en: The finis family includes finish, finite, infinite, define, final, finance and refine; all turn on the idea of a boundary or an end.
latinIntro.cn: finis 词族包括 finish、finite、infinite、define、final、finance、refine，核心都围绕边界或终点。

items.meaning: the act or result of making fine
items.meaningCN: 使变精细的动作或结果
items.example: The refinement of the lens improved resolution.
items.exampleCN: 镜头的改进提高了分辨率。

items.meaning: to purify or make more exact
items.example: The team refined the estimate with new data.
items.exampleCN: 团队用新数据细化了估算。

items.example: Refined sugar pours more freely.
The refinery processes crude oil.

items.meaning: one who or that which refines
items.example: The refiner removed sulfur from the metal.
items.exampleCN: 精炼者从金属中去除了硫。

items.example: The glossary defines each term.
items.exampleCN: 术语表为每个词下定义。

items.example: The supply is finite.
She finished the report at midnight.

latinEntries.meaning: to bound, limit; to make fine
suffix forming nouns of act or result
latinEntries.meaningCN: 构成动作或结果名词的后缀

definition_zh: 解释；说明；占比例；报账；对行为负责；清点；计入
definition_en: to explain or answer for something, to form a part of a total, or to give a reckoning of money, goods or conduct
core_image: 账房桌上摊开一本账簿，左页记进项，右页记去向，掌柜用笔逐条对上
scene: 月底账房把账簿摊在桌上，左边记进项，右边记去向，掌柜用笔逐条对上。 The manager must account for every sum in the ledger.
sceneCN: 这里指对每一笔款项作出说明（第 1 个义项：解释原因）；句意为经理必须对账簿里的每一笔金额作出交代。图中可辨识物件：账簿、毛笔、封存的票据。

pos.zh: 解释；说明；占比例；报账；负责

derivatives.zh: 短语的核心名词兼动词，义为「账目；说明」
由短语核心词加形容词尾构成，义为「负有交代责任的」
由该形容词加名词尾构成，义为「问责；责任」
由核心动词加名词尾构成，义为「会计；记账」
由核心词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「会计员」

senses.title: To explain a cause
senses.definition: to give a reason or explanation for something that happened
senses.definitionCN: 为已经发生的事给出理由或解释
senses.example: The engineer can account for the delay in the schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师能够解释进度延误的原因。
senses.why: The word began as a reckoning of money, and a reckoning is first of all a statement that answers a question.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指银钱的清算，而清算首先就是一份回答问题的交代。

senses.title: To explain a difference or phenomenon
senses.definition: to show why two things differ or why an observed fact is as it is
senses.definitionCN: 说明两件事为何不同，或说明观察到的现象为何如此
senses.example: The new model will account for the gap between the two readings.
senses.exampleCN: 新模型将说明两次读数之间差距的由来。
senses.why: An account must balance two sides, so the phrase naturally covers explaining a gap rather than only naming a cause.
senses.whyCN: 账目必须两边对得上，因此这个短语自然可以说明差距的由来，而不只是指出一个原因。

senses.title: To form a share of a total
senses.definition: to be a particular part of a whole, usually expressed as a number or percentage
senses.definitionCN: 构成整体中的某个部分，通常用数字或百分比表示
senses.example: Renewable sources may account for a third of the grid.
senses.exampleCN: 可再生能源可能占电网供应的三分之一。
senses.why: In a ledger each entry has a size, and that size as a share of the total became the modern statistical sense.
senses.whyCN: 账簿里每一笔都有大小，而它占总数的份额就成了现代统计义。

senses.title: To make up a total
senses.definition: to be the substance or component of a whole, considered as one of its parts
senses.definitionCN: 作为一个部分，构成整体的实质或成分
senses.example: Small firms can account for most of the new jobs.
senses.exampleCN: 小企业可能构成大部分新增岗位。
senses.why: The same arithmetic picture is read from the other side: the part does not merely occupy a share, it makes up the whole.
senses.whyCN: 同一幅算术图从另一侧读：部分不只是占了份额，而是把整体组成起来。

senses.title: To give a reckoning of money
senses.definition: to record and explain how money received or spent has been used
senses.definitionCN: 记录并说明收到或花出的钱是如何使用的
senses.example: The treasurer must account for the funds received in March.
senses.exampleCN: 财务主管必须说明三月收到的资金去向。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: an account is a written reckoning presented to someone who has the right to check it.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：账目就是呈交给有权核查者的一份书面清算。

senses.title: To answer for one's conduct
senses.definition: to take responsibility for an action and accept that one may be questioned or blamed for it
senses.definitionCN: 对某一行为承担责任，并接受因此受到质询或责备
senses.example: The officer will account for his decision to the board.
senses.exampleCN: 这名官员将向董事会为自己的决定作出交代。
senses.why: Money and conduct are both things that can be rendered up to another person, so the financial phrase extended to moral duty.
senses.whyCN: 钱和行为都是可以向他人交出的东西，因此这个财务短语扩展到了道义责任。

senses.title: To check goods one by one
senses.definition: to list and check every item or unit so that the record matches what is present
senses.definitionCN: 逐项列出并核对每个物品或单位，使记录与实际相符
senses.example: Two clerks can account for every item in the store.
senses.exampleCN: 两名职员能够把仓库里的每件物品清点清楚。
senses.why: A shopkeeper counts stock before writing the account, so counting and accounting share one verb.
senses.whyCN: 店主先清点存货再记账，因此清点与记账共用同一个动词。

senses.title: To include in a calculation or plan
senses.definition: to include something as a factor when judging, planning or calculating
senses.definitionCN: 在判断、计划或计算时把某事物作为一个因素纳入
senses.example: The budget should account for the rise in fuel costs.
senses.exampleCN: 预算应当把燃料成本上升计入考虑。
senses.why: The modern planning sense treats every relevant factor as an entry that must appear on the ledger.
senses.whyCN: 现代规划义把每个相关因素都当作账簿上必须出现的一笔。

intro.en: Account comes through Old French acont, a reckoning, from the verb conter, to count, which goes back to Latin computare, to reckon together, formed from com-, together, and putare, to reckon or estimate. For is a native English preposition, and the phrase settled in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
intro.cn: 这个词经古法语「acont」「算账」而来，源头是动词「conter」「计数」，再往前是拉丁语「computare」「一起清算」，由「com-」「一起」和「putare」「清算、估算」构成。「for」是英语本族介词，这个短语在十六至十七世纪固定下来。

items.en: The verb meant to reckon, to estimate and also to prune, and the reckoning image runs through the whole family.
items.cn: 这个动词意为清算、估算，也有修剪之意，清算的意象贯穿整个词族。

items.en: With com-, together, the verb meant to reckon things up together, the source of count, compute and account.
items.cn: 加上表示「一起」的「com-」，动词意为把各项一起清算，是「count」「compute」「account」的共同来源。

items.en: French kept the counting sense and used it both for numbers and for telling a story.
items.cn: 法语保留了计数义，既用于数字，也用于讲述一件事。

items.en: The noun meant a reckoning or a statement of what was owed, and English borrowed it as account.
items.cn: 这个名词意为清算或应付账款的说明，英语把它借入为「account」。

items.en: English used the noun for a financial record and the verb for giving an explanation or a report.
items.cn: 英语把这一名词用于财务记录，把动词用于作出解释或报告。

items.en: From the sixteenth century, account for was used for answering for money and conduct, and by the seventeenth century for explaining and for forming a share.
items.cn: 自十六世纪起，「account for」用于为钱财和行为作出交代，到十七世纪又用于解释原因和构成比例。

note.en: The first group gathers forms built on the same counting word; the second group gathers verbs that explain, compose or answer.
note.cn: 第一组收录建立在同一个计数词上的形式；第二组收录表示解释、构成或交代的动词。

entries.definition: A record of money, or a spoken report; the core noun and verb behind the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 指账目或口头说明；是该短语背后的核心名词与动词。

entries.definition: Required to explain and answer for one's actions.
entries.definitionCN: 指有责任为自己的行为作出解释与交代的。

entries.definition: The work of keeping and checking financial records.
entries.definitionCN: 指记录与核查财务账目的工作。

entries.definition: A reduction in price; the opposite prefix pulls the counting word in another direction.
entries.definitionCN: 指价格减免；相反的前缀把计数词引向另一方向。

entries.definition: To say numbers in order or to find how many there are.
entries.definitionCN: 指按顺序数数，或求出一共有多少。

entries.definition: To make something clear by giving details or reasons.
entries.definitionCN: 指通过给出细节或理由使某事物清楚。

entries.definition: To be the parts that make up a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 指构成整体的各部分。

entries.definition: To consist of or be made up of particular parts.
entries.definitionCN: 指由某些部分构成。

entries.definition: To show that an action or claim has a good reason.
entries.definitionCN: 指证明某一行为或说法有正当理由。

entries.definition: To give a formal spoken or written account of something.
entries.definitionCN: 指对某事作正式的口头或书面报告。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the ledger behind the word, its counting family, and the real phrases of money and share.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用这个词背后的账簿、它的计数词族，以及钱财与比例的真实搭配。

normal.en: An account is first a ledger, and to account for is to make the ledger balance.
normal.cn: 账目首先是一本账簿，而「account for」就是让账簿对得上。

normal.en: Count, compute, account and accountant all descend from the same Latin reckoning word.
normal.cn: 「count」「compute」「account」与「accountant」都出自同一个拉丁清算词。

normal.en: To account for money is to say where it went; to account for a delay is to say why it happened.
normal.cn: 为钱财作出交代是说钱去了哪里；为延误作出交代是说明它为何发生。

normal.en: In a report, a group that accounts for a third is one of three equal parts.
normal.cn: 在报告里，占三分之一的群体就是三等份中的一份。

normal.en: Account for every item is the stocktaker's phrase: nothing may be left off the list.
normal.cn: 「把每件物品都清点清楚」是盘点人的说法：清单上不能漏掉任何一项。

abstract.en: Every explanation is a small ledger: cause on one side, effect on the other, and the two must balance.
abstract.cn: 每一种解释都是一本小账簿：一边是原因，一边是结果，两边必须对得上。

abstract.en: A share is a number with a seat in the whole; accounting for it is giving that seat a name.
abstract.cn: 份额是整体中占一个位置的数字；说明它，就是给那个位置一个名字。

abstract.en: Responsibility begins when someone asks you to account for what you did, not for what you meant.
abstract.cn: 责任始于别人要求你交代做了什么，而不是交代你想做什么。

examples.en: The audit must account for the missing fuel.
examples.cn: 审计必须说明缺失燃料的去向。

examples.en: Women can account for nearly half of the workforce.
examples.cn: 女性可能占劳动力的近一半。

examples.en: He could not account for the broken seal.
examples.cn: 他无法解释封条为何破损。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「阿康特·佛」——账要对得上，原因要说得出：解释、占比、报账

root: 古法语「acont」「算账」←「conter」「计数」← 拉丁语「computare」「一起清算」=「com-」「一起」+「putare」「清算、估算」；「for」为英语本族介词，短语于十六至十七世纪固定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses fan out from the ledger: explaining a cause, explaining a difference, taking a share, making up a total, reporting money, answering for conduct, checking stock, and including a factor in a plan.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从账簿向外展开：解释原因、说明差异、占比例、构成总量、报账、为行为负责、清点存货、把因素计入计划。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ledger lies open, entries on both sides, and a brush moves down the column until the sums agree.
core.cn: 核心意象：账簿摊开，两边都是条目，笔沿着栏目往下走，直到数目相符。

branches.en: THE EXPLANATION: a cause is named, and a puzzling difference is made to balance.
branches.cn: 解释：指出一个原因，并让令人困惑的差异对得上。

branches.en: THE SHARE: a part is measured against the whole, and then treated as what makes the whole up.
branches.cn: 份额：部分被放在整体中衡量，随后又被视为构成整体的成分。

branches.en: THE RECKONING: money is reported and stock is counted until the record matches the shelf.
branches.cn: 清算：报告款项并清点存货，直到记录与货架相符。

branches.en: THE ANSWER: conduct is handed over to someone with the right to question it.
branches.cn: 交代：行为被交给有权质询的人。

branches.en: THE FACTOR: a future cost or condition becomes an entry that the plan must include.
branches.cn: 因素：未来的成本或条件成为计划必须列入的一笔。

intro.en: The phrase is built from a Latin counting word and a native English preposition, and its family is full of money words.
intro.cn: 这个短语由一个拉丁计数词和一个英语本族介词构成，其词族里满是与钱有关的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies putare and computare; Old French shortened the verb to conter and the noun to acont before English took them.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「putare」与「computare」；古法语把动词缩短为「conter」、名词缩短为「acont」，英语随后借用。

items.example: The prefix gathers separate sums into one total.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把分开的数目聚成一个总数。

items.meaning: to reckon, to estimate, to prune
items.example: The verb is the seed of the whole counting family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是整个计数词族的种子。

items.structure: Latin verb from com- and putare
items.example: It is the source of count and compute.
French used one verb for numbers and for narrative.
items.exampleCN: 法语用同一个动词表示数字与叙述。

items.meaning: a reckoning, a statement of what is owed
items.example: The noun came into English as account.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词进入英语成为「account」。

items.meaning: with respect to, on behalf of
items.example: The native preposition marks what the account is about.
items.exampleCN: 这个本族介词标出账目所涉及的对象。

items.meaning: a record of money; to explain
items.example: English split the borrowed noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 英语把借来的名词与动词兼用。

items.example: It forms the word for being answerable.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「应被交代」的词。

items.example: It names the work of keeping books.

definition_en: the reduction or disappearance of the natural places where species live
core_image: 推土机推过一片林地，鸟群在空中盘旋却无处落下
scene: 这里指「栖息地丧失」。 Logging caused habitat loss across most of the valley within a decade.
sceneCN: 这里 habitat loss 是「栖息地丧失」（第 1 个义项：物种自然栖息地的减少或消失）；句意：伐木在十年之内造成山谷大部分地区的栖息地丧失。

senses.title: The disappearance of living space
senses.definition: the reduction or complete disappearance of the natural environment a species needs
senses.definitionCN: 物种所需自然环境的减少或完全消失
senses.example: Habitat loss is the leading threat to amphibians worldwide.
senses.exampleCN: 栖息地丧失是全球两栖动物的首要威胁。
senses.why: The phrase names a state and a process at once: the place is lost, and the losing is ongoing.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语同时命名状态与过程：场所已经失去，而失去仍在持续。

senses.title: A shrinking area
senses.definition: a decline in the total area of a particular habitat type
senses.definitionCN: 某一类栖息地总面积的下降
senses.example: Satellite images measured habitat loss in the wetland over thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 卫星影像测量了这片湿地三十年间栖息地面积的减少。
senses.why: Remote sensing quantifies loss as area, turning the phrase into a measurable variable.
senses.whyCN: 遥感把丧失量化为面积，使这个说法成为一个可测量的变量。

senses.title: Loss through degradation
senses.definition: the effective loss of habitat quality even where the area remains
senses.definitionCN: 面积虽在、栖息地质量却实际丧失的情况
senses.example: Pollution caused habitat loss without removing a single hectare.
senses.exampleCN: 污染造成栖息地丧失，却没有减少一公顷面积。
senses.why: Conservation practice treats unusable habitat as lost, so quality counts as well as area.
senses.whyCN: 保护实践把无法使用的栖息地也算作丧失，因此质量与面积同等重要。

senses.title: Loss through land conversion
senses.definition: the conversion of natural land to farms, roads, mines or cities
senses.definitionCN: 把自然土地转为农田、道路、矿场或城市
senses.example: The road project accounted for most of the habitat loss in the corridor.
senses.exampleCN: 道路工程是该走廊栖息地丧失的主要原因。
senses.why: This sense focuses on the human action that removes habitat, the commonest cause in policy documents.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项聚焦于移除栖息地的人类行为，也是政策文件中最常见的成因表述。

senses.title: A conservation threat
senses.titleCN: 保护生物学中的威胁因子
senses.definition: in conservation biology, one of the main pressures ranked against species survival
senses.definitionCN: 保护生物学中按物种存续风险排序的主要压力之一
senses.example: The assessment listed habitat loss ahead of hunting and climate change.
senses.exampleCN: 这项评估把栖息地丧失排在捕猎与气候变化之前。
senses.why: Threat ranking needs a stable label, so the phrase became a standard category in red lists.
senses.whyCN: 威胁排序需要一个稳定的标签，因此这个说法成为红色名录中的标准类别。

senses.title: A driver of extinction
senses.definition: a process that raises extinction risk by removing the places species depend on
senses.definitionCN: 通过移除物种依赖的场所而提高灭绝风险的过程
senses.example: Habitat loss drove the island's endemic birds to the edge of extinction.
senses.exampleCN: 栖息地丧失把这岛上的特有鸟类推向灭绝边缘。
senses.why: The phrase connects a local change to a global outcome, which is why it dominates extinction analysis.
senses.whyCN: 这个说法把局部变化与全球结果连接起来，因此它在灭绝分析中占主导地位。

senses.title: A policy and legal category
senses.definition: in law and planning, the loss of habitat that must be avoided, mitigated or compensated
senses.definitionCN: 法律与规划中必须避免、减缓或补偿的栖息地损失
senses.example: The developer paid for habitat loss compensation on an adjacent site.
senses.exampleCN: 开发商为邻近场地的栖息地丧失支付了补偿。
senses.why: Regulation turns the ecological fact into an obligation, and the phrase names the item to be balanced.
senses.whyCN: 监管把生态事实变成义务，这个说法命名的是需要被平衡的项目。

senses.title: Loss of a familiar setting
senses.definition: figuratively, the disappearance of the conditions in which a group or activity once thrived
senses.definitionCN: 比喻指某群体或活动曾赖以繁荣的条件消失
senses.example: Small bookshops faced habitat loss as the high street changed.
senses.exampleCN: 随着商业街变迁，小书店面临「栖息地丧失」的处境。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the ecological structure: a way of life needs a place, and the place is going away.
senses.whyCN: 这个隐喻保留了生态结构：一种生活方式需要场所，而场所正在消失。

intro.en: Habitat loss is a modern compound of a Latin verb form and an Old English noun.
intro.cn: habitat loss 是现代复合词，由拉丁语动词形式与古英语名词构成。

items.en: Habitat is the third-person singular present of Latin habitare, 'to dwell', itself frequentative of habere, 'to have, hold'. It appears in Latin texts as 'it dwells here'.
items.cn: habitat 是拉丁语 habitare「居住」的第三人称单数现在时，而 habitare 又是 habere「拥有、持有」的反复形式。它在拉丁语文本中意为「它住在这里」。

items.en: English naturalists adopted habitat in the eighteenth century for the place where a species lives, probably through translations of Latin botanical descriptions.
items.cn: 英语博物学家在 18 世纪采用 habitat 指物种生活的地方，大概是通过拉丁植物描述的翻译而来。

items.en: Loss comes from Old English los, 'destruction, loss', related to the verb leosan, 'to lose'. It is native Germanic, not Latin.
items.cn: loss 来自古英语 los「毁坏、丧失」，与动词 leosan「失去」相关，属本族日耳曼语，而非拉丁语。

items.en: Habitat loss became a standard phrase with twentieth-century conservation biology, as habitat destruction was identified as the main cause of species decline. The exact first use is not firmly dated.
items.cn: 随着 20 世纪保护生物学的发展，habitat loss 成为标准说法，因为栖息地破坏被认定是物种衰退的主要原因。确切首见年代尚无定论。

items.en: Late twentieth-century environmental law and planning adopted the phrase for impacts to be avoided, mitigated or offset.
items.cn: 20 世纪后期的环境法与规划采用这一说法，指必须避免、减缓或抵消的影响。

note.en: The first group is easily confused with the phrase; the second holds related conservation terms.
note.cn: 第一组容易与这个短语混淆；第二组是相关保护术语。

entries.definition: A decline in habitat quality while the area remains; habitat loss usually implies area is gone.
entries.definitionCN: 面积仍在而质量下降；habitat loss 通常意味着面积已经消失。

entries.definition: The division of habitat into isolated patches; the total area may be similar, but connectivity is lost.
entries.definitionCN: 栖息地被切成孤立斑块；总面积可能相近，但连通性丧失。

entries.definition: The physical removal of habitat; habitat loss is the resulting reduction, which can also come from degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 对栖息地的物理清除；habitat loss 是由此导致的减少，也可由退化引起。

entries.definition: The clearing of forest, a major cause of habitat loss but not the whole category.
entries.definitionCN: 砍伐森林，是栖息地丧失的主要原因之一，但不等于整个类别。

entries.definition: Changing natural land to another use; it is the usual mechanism behind habitat loss.
entries.definitionCN: 把自然土地改为其他用途；是栖息地丧失背后的常见机制。

entries.definition: The decline of species and genetic variety; habitat loss is one of its main drivers.
entries.definitionCN: 物种与遗传多样性的下降；栖息地丧失是其主因之一。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the Latin 'it dwells' and the standard conservation pairings.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：拉丁语「它居住」与标准保护搭配。

normal.en: habitat is literally 'it dwells'; habitat loss is the dwelling going away.
normal.cn: habitat 字面就是「它居住」；habitat loss 就是住所消失。

normal.en: The standard pair is habitat loss and fragmentation.
normal.cn: 标准配对是栖息地丧失与破碎化。

normal.en: Area, quality and connectivity give the three related terms: loss, degradation, fragmentation.
normal.cn: 面积、质量与连通性对应三个相关术语：丧失、退化、破碎化。

normal.en: Policy phrases include driver of habitat loss and habitat loss compensation.
normal.cn: 政策搭配包括栖息地丧失的驱动因素与栖息地丧失补偿。

normal.en: The bulldozer at the forest edge is the word's plainest image.
normal.cn: 林缘的推土机，是这个词最朴素的画面。

abstract.en: Think of a theatre losing its stage: the actors remain, but there is nowhere to perform.
abstract.cn: 想象一座剧院失去舞台：演员还在，却没有地方演出。

abstract.en: A species without habitat is a key without a lock.
abstract.cn: 没有栖息地的物种，就是一把没有锁的钥匙。

abstract.en: In business, habitat loss means the street changed before the shop did.
abstract.cn: 在商业里，栖息地丧失意味着街道变了，而店铺还没变。

examples.en: Agriculture is the largest single cause of habitat loss worldwide.
examples.cn: 农业是全球栖息地丧失最大的单一原因。

examples.en: The reserve was created to slow habitat loss along the river.
examples.cn: 设立保护区是为了减缓沿河的栖息地丧失。

examples.en: The report links habitat loss to the decline of migratory birds.
examples.cn: 报告把栖息地丧失与候鸟数量下降联系起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: habitat（住处）+ loss（失去）→ 栖息地丧失

root: habitat 为拉丁语 habitare「居住」的第三人称单数形式，源自 habere「拥有、持有」；loss 来自古英语 los「毁坏、丧失」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe a needed place disappearing: as a state, an area, a quality, a land-use change, a ranked threat, an extinction driver, a legal item and a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都描述「所需场所消失」：作为状态、面积、质量、土地转用、排序威胁、灭绝驱动、法律项目与隐喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a place that life needs, taken away.
core.cn: 核心意象：生命所需的场所被拿走。

branches.en: THE CORE: the place is gone, and the loss can be measured as area.
branches.cn: 核心：场所消失，而丧失可以用面积来测量。

branches.en: THE MECHANISMS: quality can fall without area shrinking, and land can be converted to other uses.
branches.cn: 机制：面积不缩小时质量也会下降，土地也可被转为其他用途。

branches.en: THE CONSEQUENCE: conservation ranks the pressure, and extinction analysis names it as a driver.
branches.cn: 后果：保护学对它排序，灭绝分析把它列为驱动因素。

branches.en: THE RULE: law turns the loss into something to avoid, mitigate or compensate.
branches.cn: 规则：法律把这种丧失变成需要避免、减缓或补偿的事项。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: any way of life can lose the conditions that supported it.
branches.cn: 隐喻：任何生活方式都可能失去支撑它的条件。

intro.en: The phrase combines a Latin-derived noun of dwelling with a native Germanic noun of losing.
intro.cn: 这个短语把源自拉丁语的「居住」名词与本族日耳曼语的「失去」名词组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Habitat is Latin habitare 'to dwell', from habere 'to have'; loss is Old English los, with no Latin element.
latinIntro.cn: habitat 是拉丁语 habitare「居住」，源自 habere「拥有」；loss 是古英语 los，不含拉丁语成分。

items.example: Habitat loss threatens the coastal marsh.
items.exampleCN: 栖息地丧失威胁着这片滨海沼泽。

items.meaning: the place where a species lives
items.example: The bird's habitat is shrinking.
items.exampleCN: 这种鸟的栖息地正在缩小。

items.meaning: the act or state of losing
items.example: The loss of the marsh was gradual.
items.exampleCN: 这片沼泽的丧失是渐进的。

items.example: Habitat degradation can precede outright loss.
items.exampleCN: 栖息地退化可能先于彻底丧失。

items.example: Habitat fragmentation isolates small populations.
items.exampleCN: 栖息地破碎化使小种群孤立。

items.example: Habitat restoration can reverse part of the loss.
items.exampleCN: 栖息地恢复可以挽回部分丧失。

items.example: Deforestation is a common cause of habitat loss.
items.exampleCN: 毁林是栖息地丧失的常见原因。

items.meaning: the dying out of a species
items.example: Habitat loss raises extinction risk.
items.exampleCN: 栖息地丧失提高灭绝风险。

definition_zh: 敏锐；精明；洞察力
definition_en: the ability to think quickly and make sharp judgments, especially in a practical field
core_image: 谈判桌上，一眼看穿对方报价里的漏洞
scene: 拍卖会里，别人还在犹豫，他已经从落款和纸张判断出这幅画的年代。 Her business acumen turned a small shop into a chain.
sceneCN: 这里 acumen 是「精明、商业头脑」（第 1 个义项：在实务中做出敏锐判断的能力）；句意为她的商业头脑把小店做成了连锁。

derivatives.zh: 同源形容词，义为「敏锐的；剧烈的」
同源副词，义为「敏锐地；强烈地」

senses.title: Sharp judgment
senses.definition: the ability to see quickly what is true or useful
senses.definitionCN: 迅速看出真实或有用之处的能力
senses.example: Her business acumen turned a small shop into a chain.
senses.exampleCN: 她的商业头脑把小店做成了连锁。
senses.why: Latin acumen meant 'a sharp point', so the mind is pictured as a blade that cuts through confusion.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 acumen 意为「尖点」，因此心智被想象成切开混乱的刀刃。

senses.title: Practical skill in a field
senses.definition: specialized shrewdness in business, law, or another practical area
senses.definitionCN: 在商业、法律等实务领域的专门精明
senses.example: The firm hired him for his legal acumen.
senses.exampleCN: 公司因他的法律才干而聘用他。
senses.why: The word is often paired with a field name, because sharpness shows itself in a particular trade.
senses.whyCN: 这个词常与领域名称搭配，因为敏锐总是在具体行当里显现。

intro.en: Acumen comes straight from Latin acumen, 'a sharp point', from acuere, 'to sharpen', the root of acute.
intro.cn: acumen 直接来自拉丁语 acumen（尖点），源自 acuere（磨尖），是 acute 的词根。

items.en: acuere meant 'to sharpen, to make keen'.
items.cn: acuere 意为「磨尖、使敏锐」。

items.en: acumen meant 'a sharp point or sting'.
items.cn: acumen 意为「尖点、刺」。

items.en: acutus meant 'sharpened, keen', the source of acute.
items.cn: acutus 意为「磨尖的、敏锐的」，是 acute 的来源。

items.en: English acumen first named sharpness of mind.
items.cn: 英语 acumen 最初指心智的敏锐。

items.en: modern usage pairs it with business and legal fields.
items.cn: 现代用法把它与商业、法律等领域搭配。

note.en: The first group gathers the sharp-root family; the second gathers words for mental sharpness.
note.cn: 第一组收「尖」词根词族；第二组收表示心智敏锐的词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning 'sharp or severe'.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「敏锐的；剧烈的」

entries.definition: The adverb meaning 'sharply or intensely'.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「敏锐地；强烈地」

entries.definition: The noun for sharpness of sense or mind.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「敏锐度」

entries.definition: The ability to see into a situation.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「洞察力」

entries.definition: The ability to make good decisions.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「判断力」

entries.definition: Practical cleverness in dealing with people.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「精明」

normalIntro.en: The normal hooks use the sharp-point root and the auction scene; the abstract hooks picture a blade cutting through fog.
normalIntro.cn: 常规记忆点用「尖点」词根与拍卖场景；抽象记忆点想象刀刃切开迷雾。

normal.en: Acumen is a sharp point of the mind: acuere means sharpen.
normal.cn: acumen 是心智的尖点：acuere 意为磨尖。

normal.en: Business acumen is the most common pair.
normal.cn: business acumen 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: The word is uncountable in normal use.
normal.cn: 这个词通常不可数。

normal.en: Acute and acuity share the same sharp root.
normal.cn: acute 与 acuity 共享同一个「尖」词根。

normal.en: Acumen is practical; insight can be abstract.
normal.cn: acumen 偏实务，insight 可以更抽象。

abstract.en: Picture an eye catching a flaw in a price sheet.
abstract.cn: 想象一眼看出报价单里的漏洞。

abstract.en: Picture a blade cutting clean through fog.
abstract.cn: 想象刀刃干净地切开迷雾。

abstract.en: Picture a trader reading a market before others.
abstract.cn: 想象交易员比旁人先读懂市场。

examples.en: Her business acumen turned a small shop into a chain.
examples.cn: 她的商业头脑把小店做成了连锁。

examples.en: The firm hired him for his legal acumen.
examples.cn: 公司因他的法律才干而聘用他。

examples.en: Judges respected her sharp acumen.
examples.cn: 法官们敬重她敏锐的洞察力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿丘门」——心里那根尖针一扎就中，就是敏锐。

root: 拉丁语 acuere（磨尖）→ acumen（尖点）；核心义是「心智像尖刃一样切开疑难」

sensesIntro.en: The senses move from sharp judgment in general, to specialized shrewdness in a field.
sensesIntro.cn: 这些义项从普遍的敏锐判断，走到某一领域的专门精明。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a blade cutting through fog
core.cn: 核心意象：刀刃切开迷雾

branches.en: The ability to judge quickly and sharply.
branches.cn: 迅速而敏锐判断的能力。

branches.en: Specialized shrewdness in a practical field.
branches.cn: 某实务领域的专门精明。

branches.en: The general sharpness becomes a trade skill.
branches.cn: 普遍的敏锐变成行业技能。

branches.en: The word usually needs a field name beside it.
branches.cn: 这个词通常需要旁边加领域名称。

branches.en: Both senses rest on the image of a sharp point.
branches.cn: 两个义项都立足在尖点意象上。

intro.en: The word is the Latin sharp root acum- with a short noun ending, and its wider family includes acute and acuity.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语「尖」词根 acum- 加短名词词尾，更广的词族包括 acute 与 acuity。

definition_zh: 水库；人工蓄水的水体或设施；也指储水容器
definition_en: an artificial lake or storage facility built to hold water for supply, irrigation or power
core_image: 山口一道坝把河水拦住，水面在山谷里铺开，淹没线在两岸留下清晰的痕迹
scene: 山口的坝把河水拦住，库面在山谷里铺开，岸边露出旧道路的痕迹。 A dam at the valley mouth turned the river into a large water reservoir.
sceneCN: 这里 water reservoir 指「为供水、灌溉或发电而建的人工蓄水体」（第 1 个义项：由坝拦蓄形成、可调节水量的水库）；句意为山口的大坝把河流变成一座大型水库。可辨识物件：大坝、库面、淹没线、旧路痕迹。

derivatives.zh: 水库的（作定语，罕用连字符）

senses.title: The artificial lake
senses.definition: a body of water stored behind a dam or other structure in a valley
senses.definitionCN: 在谷地中由坝或其他结构拦蓄形成的水体
senses.example: The water reservoir behind the dam supplies three towns.
senses.exampleCN: 坝后的水库供给三个城镇。
senses.why: The word names a store, not a flow: a river is turned into a place where water waits until it is needed.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是储库，而不是流动：河流被变成水可以等待、直到需要时才放出的地方。

senses.title: Capacity and regulation
senses.definition: the storage volume and the operating rule that shift water from wet to dry periods
senses.definitionCN: 把水从丰水期转移到枯水期的蓄水容积与调度规则
senses.example: The reservoir stores winter rain for the summer harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 水库把冬季的雨储存起来供夏季收获使用。
senses.why: A reservoir is useful because inflow and demand are out of step; storage is time moved from one season to another.
senses.whyCN: 水库之所以有用，是因为来水与需求不同步；蓄存就是把时间从一个季节搬到另一个季节。

senses.title: A drinking-water source
senses.definition: a protected impoundment from which treated water is drawn for cities
senses.definitionCN: 受保护、为城市取水并处理的人工蓄水体
senses.example: The city's drinking water comes from a mountain reservoir.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的饮用水来自一座山区水库。
senses.why: Storing water also settles sediment and evens out quality, so a reservoir is a treatment step as much as a supply.
senses.whyCN: 蓄水同时让泥沙沉降、使水质更稳定，因此水库既是供水设施，也是一道处理环节。

senses.title: Irrigation and hydropower
senses.definition: an impoundment that guarantees water or head for farms and turbines
senses.definitionCN: 为农田或水轮机保证水量或水头的人工蓄水体
senses.example: The reservoir releases water for the rice fields in May.
senses.exampleCN: 水库在五月放水给稻田。
senses.why: Both uses need a steady supply that nature does not provide, and a reservoir converts an irregular river into a scheduled one.
senses.whyCN: 这两种用途都需要自然无法提供的稳定供给，水库把不规则的河流变成按时刻表运行的河流。

senses.title: Sediment and ecology
senses.definition: the reservoir as a trap for sediment and a changed habitat behind the dam
senses.definitionCN: 作为泥沙陷阱、并改变坝后生境的水库
senses.example: The reservoir trapped silt that once reached the delta.
senses.exampleCN: 水库拦住了原本到达三角洲的泥沙。
senses.why: Slow water drops its load, so every reservoir necessarily fills with sediment and starves the downstream channel.
senses.whyCN: 流速变慢便卸下负载，因此每座水库都必然淤积，同时也让下游河道失去泥沙来源。

senses.title: The container sense
senses.definition: a tank or vessel that holds water in a building or machine
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物或机器中储存水的罐或容器
senses.example: A water reservoir on the roof feeds the upper floors.
senses.exampleCN: 屋顶的储水罐为上几层供水。
senses.why: The same word covers the small version: anything that holds water for later use is a reservoir, whatever its size.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也涵盖小型版本：任何为日后使用而存水的器物都是 reservoir，无论大小。

senses.title: Abstract: a reserve of anything
senses.definition: a stock of people, skills or goodwill held back for future need
senses.definitionCN: 为未来需要而保有的人才、技能或善意存量
senses.example: The scholarship fund is a reservoir of talent for the region.
senses.exampleCN: 这项奖学金基金是该地区的人才储备。
senses.why: A reservoir is defined by holding something back, and that structure can be borrowed by any resource that is stored rather than spent.
senses.whyCN: 水库的定义特征是「把东西留住」，这种结构可被任何储存而非消耗的资源借用。

senses.title: A body's water store
senses.definition: an organ or tissue in an organism that holds water or fluid
senses.definitionCN: 生物体内储存水或液体的器官或组织
senses.example: The cactus uses its stem as a water reservoir.
senses.exampleCN: 仙人掌把茎当作储水结构。
senses.why: Life solves the same problem as engineering: keep water where it will not evaporate, then draw on it slowly.
senses.whyCN: 生命与工程解决同一个问题：把水存在不会蒸发的地方，然后慢慢取用。

intro.en: Water reservoir is a hybrid: a native English noun plus a French noun that goes back to Latin reservare. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: water reservoir 是混合词：本族英语名词加上可上溯到拉丁语 reservare 的法语名词。年代为约数。

items.en: Wæter continues Proto-Germanic *watōr and belongs to the same Indo-European family as Greek hydōr.
items.cn: wæter 延续原始日耳曼语 *watōr，与希腊语 hydōr 同属一个印欧词族。

items.en: French réservoir first meant a place where something is kept back, then a store of water; English borrowed it in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 法语 réservoir 最初指把某物留住的地方，后指储水之处；英语在十七世纪借入。

items.en: Reservare meant to keep back or preserve, built from re-, back, and servare, to keep or guard.
items.cn: reservare 意为留住、保存，由 re-「向后」与 servare「保存、守护」构成。

items.en: The large artificial lake sense became standard in the nineteenth century with the growth of dam building for cities and industry.
items.cn: 随着为城市与工业建坝的增多，大型人工湖这一义项在十九世纪成为标准用法。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date of the engineering sense): dictionaries give only approximate dates for the shift from 'store' to 'impounded lake'.
items.cn: 来源不确定（工程义首见年代）：辞书对从「储库」到「拦蓄湖泊」的转变只给出约数。

note.en: The first group holds look-alike phrases for storage facilities; the second holds water bodies that are close but not built stores.
note.cn: 第一组是形近的储水设施短语；第二组是相近但并非人工储库的水体。

entries.definition: The single word, which also covers oil reservoirs, reserves of talent and host populations.
entries.definitionCN: 单词形式，也涵盖油藏、人才储备与宿主群体。

entries.definition: An enclosed container of water, usually small and built rather than impounded.
entries.definitionCN: 封闭的储水容器，通常较小且为制造物，而非拦蓄形成。

entries.definition: A raised tank whose height supplies pressure; the point is the head, not the volume.
entries.definitionCN: 以高度提供压力的架高水罐；重点在水头，不在容积。

entries.definition: A natural standing body of water; a reservoir is made, and its level is controlled.
entries.definitionCN: 天然静水体；水库是人工的，且水位受控。

entries.definition: A small body of still water, usually shallow and not managed for supply.
entries.definitionCN: 小型静水体，通常较浅，也不为供水而调度。

entries.definition: A rock layer that stores groundwater; the store is natural and invisible.
entries.definitionCN: 储存地下水的岩层；储库是天然且看不见的。

entries.definition: A tank for catching and storing rainwater, usually at a building.
entries.definitionCN: 收集并储存雨水的容器，通常位于建筑物处。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the French word for keeping back, the dam image, and the real contrast with a natural lake.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：法语中「留住」的词、大坝意象，以及与天然湖泊的真实区别。

normal.en: reservoir comes from French réserver, to keep back: a reservoir is water kept back.
normal.cn: reservoir 出自法语 réserver「留住」：水库就是把水留住。

normal.en: The dam is the door and the valley is the room: together they make the store.
normal.cn: 坝是门，谷地是房间：两者合起来就是储库。

normal.en: A lake is found; a reservoir is built and its level is managed.
normal.cn: 湖泊是找到的，水库是建成的，而且水位受调度。

normal.en: Slow water drops its sediment, so every reservoir silts up over time.
normal.cn: 流速变慢便卸下泥沙，所以每座水库都会逐渐淤积。

normal.en: The same word covers a rooftop tank, because both hold water for later.
normal.cn: 同一个词也指屋顶水箱，因为两者都为日后存水。

abstract.en: Abstractly, a reservoir is time made spatial: water from one season is placed where another season can reach it.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，水库是被空间化的时间：一个季节的水被放到另一个季节够得着的地方。

abstract.en: It is a deliberate delay, and every delay has a cost: silt, drowned land, displaced people.
abstract.cn: 它是有意的延迟，而每种延迟都有代价：淤积、被淹的土地、被迁移的人。

abstract.en: Any reserve — talent, trust, capital — works the same way and silts up in the same way if unused or misused.
abstract.cn: 任何储备——人才、信任、资本——都同样运作，若闲置或用错也会同样「淤积」。

examples.en: The water reservoir was built to carry the city through two dry years.
examples.cn: 这座水库是为让城市度过两个干旱年份而建的。

examples.en: Sediment has reduced the water reservoir's capacity by a quarter.
examples.cn: 泥沙已使这座水库的库容减少了四分之一。

examples.en: A small water reservoir on the roof keeps pressure steady on the top floor.
examples.cn: 屋顶的小储水罐让顶层的压力保持稳定。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「水（water）+ 留住（reservoir）」——把水留在大坝后面 → 水库

root: 古英语 wæter「水」+ 法语 réservoir（上溯拉丁语 reservare「留住」，re- + servare「保存」）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one store: the artificial lake, its capacity, its use for drinking water, its role in irrigation and power, its sediment and ecology, the small container, the abstract reserve, and the water store inside a living body.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一处储库展开：人工湖、库容、饮用水用途、灌溉与发电中的作用、泥沙与生态影响、小型容器、抽象储备，以及生物体内的储水结构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dam closing a valley, water spreading flat behind it, an old road disappearing under the surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道坝封住谷口，水在坝后摊平，一条旧路没入水面。

branches.en: STORE AND SCHEDULE: the lake holds water, and the rule decides when it leaves.
branches.cn: 储存与调度：湖把水存住，规则决定它何时离开。

branches.en: TWO DEMANDS: cities need clean water, farms and turbines need guaranteed flow.
branches.cn: 两种需求：城市要干净的水，农田与水轮机要保证的流量。

branches.en: SIDE EFFECT: still water traps sediment and rewrites the habitat.
branches.cn: 副作用：静水拦住泥沙，也改写了生境。

branches.en: SCALE DOWN: the same word serves a tank on a roof.
branches.cn: 缩小尺度：同一个词也用于屋顶水箱。

branches.en: RESERVE AND BODY: anything held back is a reservoir, including water inside a plant.
branches.cn: 储备与身体：任何被留住的东西都是储库，包括植物体内的水。

intro.en: Water reservoir combines a native noun with a French borrowing, and the second member brings the whole Latin family of reservare.
intro.cn: water reservoir 把一个本族名词与一个法语借词组合起来，第二个成分带来了 reservare 的整个拉丁词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is reservare, from re- back and servare to keep or guard. Reserve, reservation, reserved and preserve all belong to this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语基础是 reservare，由 re-「向后」与 servare「保存、守护」构成。reserve、reservation、reserved 与 preserve 都属于这个词族。

items.meaning: to keep back for later use
items.example: They reserved two seats.

items.meaning: an arrangement kept back for someone
items.example: The reservation is for eight o'clock.

items.meaning: kept for a purpose; also holding back in manner
items.meaningCN: 预留给某用途的；也指态度含蓄的
items.example: These seats are reserved.

items.meaning: a place or thing that stores something
items.meaningCN: 储存某物的地方或器物
items.example: The reservoir supplies the valley.

items.meaning: to keep safe from harm or change
items.example: The trust preserves the old documents.
items.exampleCN: 这家信托机构保存旧文件。

items.example: Water conservation begins with fixing leaks.
The observation was recorded hourly.
items.exampleCN: 这次观测每小时记录一次。

items.meaning: a barrier built to hold back water
items.example: The dam created the reservoir.

items.meaning: the water body created by damming
items.meaningCN: 由筑坝拦蓄形成的水体
items.example: The impoundment flooded the old road.

latinEntries.structure: servare (Latin verb, to keep, guard, preserve)

definition_zh: 水循环；水在海洋、大气与陆地之间蒸发、凝结、降水、径流并回归的往复过程
definition_en: the continuous circulation of water between ocean, atmosphere and land through evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff
core_image: 一滴水从海面被太阳抬上天空，凝成云，落回山脊，顺河归海，再被抬起，画出一个闭合的圈
scene: 地理课的玻璃箱里，灯照着水面，水汽升到顶盖凝成细珠，随后一滴滴落回箱底。 In the classroom tank, the water cycle repeats as vapour rises, condenses on the lid and falls back.
sceneCN: 这里 water cycle 指「水在海洋、大气与陆地之间往复的完整回路」（第 1 个义项：以蒸发、凝结、降水与径流为环节的闭环过程）；句意为课堂演示箱中水汽上升、在顶盖凝结、又落回原处，这一回路反复出现。可辨识物件：玻璃箱、台灯、水面、顶盖雾珠、下落水滴。

pos.zh: 水循环；水文循环（不可数，指自然界水的往复过程）

forms.label: 通常形式（不可数，指过程）
复数（指多个回路或多次循环）

derivatives.zh: 水循环的（作定语，如 water-cycle model）

senses.title: Evaporation lifts water
senses.titleCN: 蒸发：水离开水面升入空中
senses.definition: the step in which surface water changes into vapour and rises into the air
senses.definitionCN: 表层水变成水汽并升入空中的环节
senses.example: Sunlight on the lake drives evaporation, the first step of the cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 阳光照在湖面上促成蒸发，这是循环的第一步。
senses.why: The loop has to start somewhere, and it starts at the boundary between liquid and air, where heat gives molecules enough energy to escape the surface.
senses.whyCN: 这个回路总要有一个起点，而起点就在水与大气的交界处：热量给了水分子足够的能量，让它们脱离水面。

senses.title: Condensation builds cloud
senses.titleCN: 凝结：水汽在冷空气中聚成云
senses.definition: the step in which rising vapour cools and turns into tiny droplets that form clouds
senses.definitionCN: 上升的水汽遇冷变成微小水滴并聚成云的环节
senses.example: The vapour cools as it rises, and condensation turns it into cloud.
senses.exampleCN: 水汽上升时冷却，凝结作用把它变成云。
senses.why: What goes up must cool: air expands with height, loses heat, and can no longer hold the same amount of vapour, so the excess returns to droplets.
senses.whyCN: 上升的东西必然变冷：空气随高度膨胀、失热，再也容纳不下同样多的水汽，多出的部分就重新变回小水滴。

senses.title: Precipitation returns water
senses.titleCN: 降水：云中的水重新落回地面
senses.definition: the step in which droplets grow heavy enough to fall as rain, snow or hail
senses.definitionCN: 水滴增大到足够重时以雨、雪或冰雹落回地面的环节
senses.example: Precipitation over the mountains feeds every stream below.
senses.exampleCN: 山上的降水补给山下的每一条溪流。
senses.why: A cloud is only a temporary holding place; once droplets merge and grow, gravity takes over and the water leaves the air.
senses.whyCN: 云只是暂时的存放处；一旦水滴合并变大，重力接管，水就离开大气落下来。

senses.title: Runoff and rivers
senses.titleCN: 径流：水沿地表汇入河流
senses.definition: the step in which water flows over the land surface into streams and rivers and back toward the sea
senses.definitionCN: 水沿陆地表层流入溪流、河流并归海的环节
senses.example: Runoff carries the storm water down to the river within hours.
senses.exampleCN: 径流在几小时内就把暴雨的水送到河里。
senses.why: Falling water seeks the lowest path. The land slopes, so the same water that fell on the ridge is delivered to the sea by gravity, not by pumps.
senses.whyCN: 落下的水会寻找最低处。地面有坡度，于是落在山脊上的水靠重力而非水泵被送到海里。

senses.title: Infiltration into the ground
senses.titleCN: 下渗：水渗入土壤与岩层
senses.definition: the step in which part of the water sinks into soil and rock instead of running off
senses.definitionCN: 部分水不流走而渗入土壤与岩石的环节
senses.example: Sandy soil allows deep infiltration, so less water reaches the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 沙质土壤下渗很深，因此到达溪流的水更少。
senses.why: The loop has two return roads: the surface road and the underground road. Infiltration is where the water chooses the second one.
senses.whyCN: 这个回路有两条归路：地表之路与地下之路。下渗就是水选择第二条路的地方。

senses.title: A balanced budget
senses.titleCN: 水量平衡：收入与支出相抵
senses.definition: the accounting view in which precipitation equals evaporation, runoff and storage change combined
senses.definitionCN: 把降水与蒸发、径流和蓄量变化相加后相抵的核算视角
senses.example: Over a year, the basin's water cycle must balance its inputs and outputs.
senses.exampleCN: 一年之内，流域的水循环必须让输入与输出相抵。
senses.why: Because the loop is closed, nothing can be added or lost overall; every drop that arrives must be accounted for somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 因为回路是闭合的，总体上既不能增加也不能丢失；每一滴到来的水都必须在某处被记账。

senses.title: The textbook diagram
senses.titleCN: 教材模型：带箭头的示意图
senses.definition: the simplified teaching model with labelled arrows showing each transfer
senses.definitionCN: 用带标注的箭头显示每一段转移的简化教学模型
senses.example: The exam asked students to label the water cycle from memory.
senses.exampleCN: 考试要求学生凭记忆给水循环图标注。
senses.why: A real cycle is invisible and planetary in scale, so teaching replaces it with a small set of arrows that can be drawn on one page.
senses.whyCN: 真实的水循环看不见，而且有行星尺度，所以教学用一个能画在一页纸上的箭头集合来代替它。

senses.title: Abstract: any repeated circulation
senses.definition: any resource or influence that keeps returning through the same set of stages
senses.definitionCN: 任何沿同一组环节不断返回的资源或影响
senses.example: Fashion runs on its own water cycle of revival and decay.
senses.exampleCN: 时尚有它自己的一套兴衰流转。
senses.why: Once a closed loop of stages is named after water, the name can be lent to money, ideas or styles that also come back around.
senses.whyCN: 一旦一套闭合的环节以水命名，这个名字就可以借给同样会绕回来的金钱、观念或风格。

intro.en: Water is a native Old English word; cycle came from Greek through Latin. The compound is an English scientific description, not a borrowed phrase. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: water 是古英语本族词；cycle 经拉丁语来自希腊语。这个复合词是英语的科学描述，不是借来的短语。年代为约数。

items.en: Old English wæter 'water' continues Proto-Germanic *watōr, and Greek hydōr 'water' is a cognate from the same Indo-European root.
items.cn: 古英语 wæter「水」延续原始日耳曼语 *watōr，希腊语 hydōr「水」同出这一印欧词根。

items.en: Greek kyklos meant circle, wheel or turning; Latin borrowed it as cyclus, and English took the Latin form in the fourteenth century with the sense of a recurring round.
items.cn: 希腊语 kyklos 指圆圈、车轮或转动；拉丁语借作 cyclus，英语在十四世纪引入这一拉丁形式，义为反复的一轮。

items.en: Natural philosophers of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries described water as circulating between sea, air and land, and the two-word label followed from that description.
items.cn: 十七、十八世纪的自然哲学家用「循环」描述水在海、气、陆之间的往复，这个双词名称就由此而来。

items.en: The technical synonyms hydrologic cycle and hydrological cycle were built later from Greek hydōr plus logos, and both remain standard in hydrology.
items.cn: 技术同义词 hydrologic cycle 与 hydrological cycle 后来由希腊语 hydōr 加 logos 构成，两者至今都是水文学的标准说法。

items.en: Source uncertain (first attestation and root shape): no dictionary fixes the first written use of the exact phrase water cycle; the Indo-European root is a reconstruction usually written *wed-, and the competing form *wod- is another reconstruction, not a proven variant.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与词根形态）：没有辞书能确定 water cycle 这一确切短语的首次书面使用；其印欧词根属重构形式，通常写作 *wed-，另有 *wod- 一说，同样只是重构，并非已证实的变体。

note.en: The first group holds phrases that name neighbouring parts of the same system; the second group holds terms that are close in meaning but are not the whole loop.
note.cn: 第一组是命名同一系统中相邻环节的短语；第二组是意思相近但并不等于整个回路的术语。

entries.definition: The same loop named from the science of hydrology rather than from the substance water.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个回路，只是从水文学科而不是从水本身命名。

entries.definition: The balance sheet of inputs and outputs within the cycle, not the cycle itself.
entries.definitionCN: 循环内部的收支账，而不是循环本身。

entries.definition: The area that collects the water; the cycle is the movement inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 收集水的区域；循环是在这个区域内发生的运动。

entries.definition: Any repeated going-round; the water cycle is one instance of circulation in nature.
entries.definitionCN: 任何反复绕行；水循环是自然界中循环的一个实例。

entries.definition: Movement of water in one direction only, without the return that makes a cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 水只朝一个方向流动，没有构成循环的回程。

entries.definition: Only the lifting stage; the cycle requires condensation, precipitation and return as well.
entries.definitionCN: 只是上升那一段；循环还需要凝结、降水与回归。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two real roots, the four named stages and the diagram students actually draw.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个真实词根、四个有名字的阶段，以及学生真正会画的那张图。

normal.en: cycle is from Greek kyklos, a wheel: a wheel returns to the point where it started.
normal.cn: cycle 出自希腊语 kyklos「车轮」：轮子转一圈会回到起点。

normal.en: The four textbook labels are evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff, in that order.
normal.cn: 教材上的四个标签依次是蒸发、凝结、降水、径流。

normal.en: hydrological adds Greek hydōr, water, to logos, study: hydrology is the study of water's behaviour.
normal.cn: hydrological 是希腊语 hydōr「水」加 logos「研究」：水文学就是研究水的行为。

normal.en: The loop has two return roads: over the land and under it.
normal.cn: 这个回路有两条归路：一条在地面之上，一条在地面之下。

normal.en: The accounting rule is simple: what falls must equal what leaves plus what is stored.
normal.cn: 记账规则很简单：落下的量等于离开的量加上储存的量。

abstract.en: Abstractly, the cycle is a closed path with no ends: every exit is also an entrance.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，这个循环是一条没有端点的闭合路径：每个出口同时也是一个入口。

abstract.en: It is also an energy story: sunlight lifts, gravity returns. Two forces drive one loop.
abstract.cn: 它也是一个能量故事：太阳负责抬起，重力负责送回。两种力驱动同一个回路。

abstract.en: Any system that must keep its accounts balanced and reuse the same material can be drawn with this loop.
abstract.cn: 任何必须保持收支平衡并重复使用同一材料的系统，都可以用这个回路来画。

examples.en: Deforestation can change the local water cycle and reduce rainfall.
examples.cn: 砍伐森林会改变局地水循环并减少降雨。

examples.en: The water cycle has no beginning and no end, so the arrows in the diagram can start anywhere.
examples.cn: 水循环没有起点也没有终点，所以示意图的箭头从哪一段开始画都可以。

examples.en: Warmer air speeds up the water cycle, making both floods and droughts more likely.
examples.cn: 更暖的空气加快水循环，使洪水和干旱都更容易发生。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「水（water）+ 圆圈（cycle）」——水在天上地下绕圈走，一圈接一圈 → 水循环

root: 古英语 wæter「水」+ 希腊语 kyklos「圆圈、转动」（经拉丁语 cyclus 进入英语）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one loop: water leaves the surface, becomes cloud, falls, and returns by two roads, then the loop itself is counted, drawn and borrowed as a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个回路展开：水离开水面、变成云、落下来、沿两条路返回，随后这个回路本身被核算、被画成图，并被借作比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ocean → vapour → cloud → rain → land → ocean, a closed wheel of water.
core.cn: 核心意象：海洋 → 水汽 → 云 → 雨 → 陆地 → 海洋，一个闭合的水之轮。

branches.en: LIFTING AND COOLING: heat takes water up, cold air turns it back into droplets.
branches.cn: 抬升与冷却：热量把水送上去，冷空气把它变回水滴。

branches.en: THE DROP: what the air can no longer hold comes down as weather.
branches.cn: 落下的那一滴：空气再也托不住的水以天气的形式落下。

branches.en: TWO RETURN ROADS: across the surface into rivers, or down into rock.
branches.cn: 两条归路：或沿地表汇入河流，或向下进入岩层。

branches.en: BALANCE: the closed loop can be audited as a budget of inputs and outputs.
branches.cn: 平衡：这个闭合回路可以当作收支账来核算。

branches.en: MODEL AND METAPHOR: the arrows teach the loop, and any returning circulation borrows its name.
branches.cn: 模型与比喻：箭头把回路教给人，而任何会返回的循环都借用它的名字。

intro.en: Water cycle is a native-English compound with one Greek-derived member, so its pieces are readable: the substance plus a word for a round.
intro.cn: water cycle 是以英语本族词为主、含一个希腊来源成分的复合词，因此可以逐块读出：物质加「一圈」。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root for water here; the Latin element is cyclus, which Rome itself borrowed from Greek kyklos. Latin has its own circulus for a ring, a different formation, so it is not listed as a cognate.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有表示水的拉丁词根；拉丁成分是 cyclus，而这个词是罗马自己从希腊语 kyklos 借来的。拉丁语另有表示圆环的 circulus，构词来源不同，因此不作为同源词列出。
