definition_zh: 主教座堂；大教堂；设有主教宝座的教堂
definition_en: the principal church of a diocese, which contains the bishop's throne and is usually a very large building
core_image: 一座巨教堂的唱诗席旁，主教的宝座比所有座椅都高，整座建筑围绕这个座位展开
scene: 石砌长廊里管风琴正在试音，回声一直滚到后殿。 The cathedral keeps the bishop's seat at the centre of the choir.
sceneCN: 这里 cathedral 指「设有主教宝座、作为一个教区首要教堂的主教座堂」（第 1 个义项：主教宝座所在的教区主堂）；句意为这座主教座堂把主教的座位安置在唱诗席的正中。图中可辨识物件：石砌长廊、管风琴、唱诗席、主教座椅。

senses.title: The bishop's principal church
senses.definition: the main church of a diocese, containing the throne of its bishop
senses.definitionCN: 一个教区的主要教堂，内置该教区主教的宝座
senses.example: The bishop entered the cathedral through the north porch.
senses.exampleCN: 主教从北侧门廊进入主教座堂。
senses.why: the word comes from the name of the seat itself, so a church is a cathedral only because a bishop's chair stands in it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自「座位」本身的名字，因此一座教堂之所以是主教座堂，只因主教的座位立在其中。

senses.title: Any very large church
senses.definition: in everyday usage, any church impressive enough to seem like a bishop's seat
senses.definitionCN: 在日常说法里，泛指任何宏伟得像是主教座堂的教堂
senses.example: Tourists call the parish church a cathedral because of its spire.
senses.exampleCN: 游客因为那座尖塔，把这座堂区教堂称作大教堂。
senses.why: size and dignity blur the technical line, so the popular sense is wider than the church's actual rank.
senses.whyCN: 体量与庄严模糊了技术界线，因此通俗义比教堂的实际等级更宽。

senses.title: A Gothic building type
senses.titleCN: 哥特式大教堂建筑类型
senses.definition: a building type defined by pointed arches, ribbed vaults, flying buttresses and a long nave
senses.definitionCN: 以尖拱、肋拱顶、飞扶壁与长中殿为特征的建筑类型
senses.example: The cathedral is studied as a machine for making coloured light.
senses.exampleCN: 这座大教堂被当作一台制造彩色光的机器来研究。
senses.why: the great medieval cathedrals solved height and light together, so the building became a type with its own engineering logic.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪的大教堂把高度与采光一并解决，因此这种建筑自成一个有工程逻辑的类型。

senses.title: The seat of a diocese
senses.definition: the church that marks the administrative centre of a diocese and its city
senses.definitionCN: 标记一个教区及其所在城市行政中心的教堂
senses.example: The small cathedral still governs a diocese larger than three counties.
senses.exampleCN: 这座不大的座堂仍管理着比三个郡还大的教区。
senses.why: a cathedral is first an administrative fact: where the seat is, there the diocese is governed.
senses.whyCN: 主教座堂首先是一个行政事实：座位在哪里，教区就在哪里受管理。

senses.title: The chapter and its clergy
senses.definition: the body of clergy attached to a cathedral, led by a dean
senses.definitionCN: 附属于座堂的教士团体，通常由座堂主任牧师领导
senses.example: The cathedral voted to keep the boys' choir after the funding cut.
senses.exampleCN: 经费削减后，座堂教士团投票决定保留男童唱诗班。
senses.why: an institution needs people, so the word shifted from the building to the chapter that runs its daily worship.
senses.whyCN: 机构需要人来运转，因此这个词从建筑转指主持其日常礼拜的教士团。

senses.title: A grand hall of another kind
senses.definition: a very large building devoted to a secular activity, described as if it were a church
senses.definitionCN: 把服务于世俗活动的大型建筑说成像教堂一样宏伟
senses.example: The old bank is a cathedral of marble, brass and guarded money.
senses.exampleCN: 那家老银行是一座由大理石、黄铜与守护着的金钱构成的殿堂。
senses.why: the metaphor borrows the cathedral's scale and hush, which is exactly what a grand secular hall wants to project.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻借用了大教堂的尺度与肃静，而这正是宏伟世俗厅堂想传达的东西。

senses.title: The bishop's chair as authority
senses.definition: the chair itself, and by extension teaching pronounced with formal authority
senses.definitionCN: 指宝座本身，并引申为以正式权威宣告的教导
senses.example: The phrase ex cathedra marks a statement made from the bishop's seat.
senses.exampleCN: ex cathedra 这个说法标记的是从主教座位上作出的宣告。
senses.why: because the chair was the seat of a teacher, speaking 'from the chair' came to mean speaking with unquestionable authority.
senses.whyCN: 因为座位是教导者的座位，「从座位上」说话就转指以不容置疑的权威说话。

senses.title: A home of choral music
senses.definition: a building whose acoustic and choral tradition make it a musical institution
senses.definitionCN: 凭声学条件与合唱传统而成为音乐机构的建筑
senses.example: The cathedral's evening service is now a concert heard online.
senses.exampleCN: 这座大教堂的晚祷现在成了网上可听的音乐会。
senses.why: stone naves and daily singing produced a repertory, so the building also names a way of performing.
senses.whyCN: 石砌中殿与每日歌唱孕育出一套曲目，因此这座建筑也代表一种演出方式。

intro.en: Cathedral comes from the Latin name of the bishop's chair, itself a Greek compound meaning 'a seat down'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: cathedral 来自拉丁语中「主教座位」的名称，而那本身是一个意为「向下坐的座位」的希腊语复合词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hedra meant a seat, chair or sitting place, and it appears in many Greek compounds for things one sits on.
items.cn: hedra 指座位、椅子或坐处，出现在许多表示「可坐之物」的希腊语复合词中。

items.en: Adding a prefix meaning 'down' gave kathedra, a seat to sit down on, especially a teacher's chair.
items.cn: 加上表示「向下」的前缀构成 kathedra，指可以坐下的座位，尤指教师的椅子。

items.en: Latin borrowed it as cathedra and used it for a chair, a teacher's throne and, in Christian usage, a bishop's seat.
items.cn: 拉丁语借作 cathedra，用于椅子、教师讲席，在基督教用法中特指主教的座位。

items.en: The adjective describing a church that held the bishop's chair gave the English noun its meaning.
items.cn: 描述「设有主教座位之教堂」的形容词，给了英语名词今天的意义。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the fourteenth century for the principal church of a diocese.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个词，指一个教区的主要教堂。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the earlier ancestry of Greek hedra is disputed, and any Indo-European form proposed for it is a reconstruction rather than a recorded word.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深来源）：希腊语 hedra 的更早谱系有争议，凡为其提出的印欧语形式都是重构形式，而非有记录的词。

note.en: Group one holds church words that look close but rank differently; group two holds sacred buildings that are not defined by a bishop's seat.
note.cn: 第一组是看起来接近、等级却不同的教堂词；第二组是不以主教座位为定义的宗教建筑。

entries.definition: The bishop's throne itself; a cathedral is named after it but the two words are not interchangeable.
entries.definitionCN: 指主教宝座本身；大教堂因它得名，但两词不能互换。

entries.definition: A church given a papal honour, or an early rectangular hall church; it may or may not also be a cathedral.
entries.definitionCN: 获教宗荣衔的教堂，或早期长方形会堂式教堂；它可能同时是主教座堂，也可能不是。

entries.definition: An English title for a church of a monastery or a very large parish church; it says nothing about a bishop.
entries.definitionCN: 英语中对修道院教堂或特大堂区教堂的称号，与主教无关。

entries.definition: A small place of worship, often inside a larger building or attached to a private house.
entries.definitionCN: 小型礼拜场所，常位于更大建筑之内或附于私宅。

entries.definition: Any building for Christian worship; a cathedral is one kind of church with a specific rank.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何基督教礼拜建筑；大教堂是其中具有特定等级的一种。

entries.definition: A monastery or its church, headed by an abbot or abbess rather than by a bishop.
entries.definitionCN: 修道院或其教堂，由院长而非主教领导。

entries.definition: A building for worship in many non-Christian traditions; it is not organized around a bishop's seat.
entries.definitionCN: 许多非基督教传统中的礼拜建筑，不以主教座位为核心。

entries.definition: The holiest room of a church, or any place of refuge; it stresses safety rather than rank.
entries.definitionCN: 教堂中最神圣的房间，或任何避难之处；强调安全而非等级。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Greek halves, the real church ranks and the real fixed phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的希腊语构件、真实的教会等级与真实的固定短语。

normal.en: Two halves: 'down' plus 'seat', so a cathedral is named for the seat inside it.
normal.cn: 两部分「向下」加「座位」，因此大教堂是因其中那座座位得名。

normal.en: The family runs cathedra, cathedral, cathedral city, cathedral choir, ex cathedra.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 cathedra、cathedral、cathedral city、cathedral choir、ex cathedra。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the building: Gothic cathedral, cathedral spire, cathedral nave.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出建筑本身：哥特式大教堂、大教堂尖塔、大教堂中殿。

normal.en: Rank matters: a cathedral has a bishop, a basilica has a papal honour, an abbey has an abbot.
normal.cn: 等级很关键：大教堂有主教，宗座圣殿有教宗荣衔，修道院教堂有院长。

normal.en: The phrase ex cathedra survives as a warning that someone is speaking as if from a throne.
normal.cn: ex cathedra 这个说法留存至今，用来提醒某人说话像从宝座上发令。

abstract.en: Picture a single empty chair that a whole town is built around.
abstract.cn: 想象一座空椅子，整座城镇都围着它建造。

abstract.en: Picture a room so tall that sound needs several seconds to come back to the speaker.
abstract.cn: 想象一间高到声音要好几秒才回到说话者耳中的屋子。

abstract.en: Picture a bank vault designed to feel like a church, with marble instead of hymns.
abstract.cn: 想象一座故意造得像教堂的金库，用大理石代替赞美诗。

examples.en: The cathedral's spire is visible from the far side of the valley.
examples.cn: 从山谷对面就能看见大教堂的尖塔。

examples.en: Repairs closed the cathedral for two winters.
examples.cn: 修缮工程让这座主教座堂关闭了两个冬天。

examples.en: The city grew rich around its cathedral and its pilgrims.
examples.cn: 这座城市因主教座堂与朝圣者而日渐富庶。

dict_mnemonic.text: cathedra（座位）→ 主教的座位所在之堂 → 主教座堂、大教堂

root: 拉丁 cathedra「座位、讲席」来自希腊 kathedra「可坐下的座位」= kata-（向下）+ hedra「座位」；英语 cathedral。hedra 的更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one object: a chair. The building is named for it, then grows into a type, an administration, a clergy body, a metaphor and a musical institution.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一件东西展开：一把椅子。建筑因它得名，随后长成一个类型、一套行政、一个教士团体、一个比喻与一个音乐机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one elevated chair in the middle of a choir, and a whole stone building arranged around that chair.
core.cn: 核心意象：唱诗席中央的一把高座，整座石造建筑都围绕着那把椅子排布。

branches.en: THE CHAIR: the first sense is simply the church that holds the bishop's seat.
branches.cn: 座位：第一个义项就是安置主教座位的那座教堂。

branches.en: SCALE AND TYPE: size makes the word popular, and medieval engineering makes it a building type.
branches.cn: 体量与类型：体量让这个词进入日常，中世纪的工程又使它成为一个建筑类型。

branches.en: ADMINISTRATION AND PEOPLE: the seat governs a diocese and supports a chapter.
branches.cn: 行政与人：座位管理一个教区，也供养一个教士团。

branches.en: AUTHORITY: the building's scale becomes a metaphor, and the chair becomes a claim to unquestionable teaching.
branches.cn: 权威：建筑的尺度变成比喻，而座位变成对不容置疑教导的宣称。

branches.en: SOUND: stone and daily singing turn the building into a musical institution.
branches.cn: 声音：石头与每日歌唱把这座建筑变成一个音乐机构。

intro.en: Cathedral is a Greek compound filtered through Latin church usage, and both halves still appear in English words.
intro.cn: cathedral 是一个经拉丁教会用法过滤的希腊语复合词，两个构件仍出现在英语词中。

latinIntro.en: Latin cathedra and the church adjective cathedralis are the direct sources; Greek supplied the two halves.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cathedra 与教会形容词 cathedralis 是直接来源，希腊语提供了两个构件。

items.example: The prefix pictures the act of sitting down.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀描绘「坐下去」的动作。

items.example: The second half names the seat itself.
items.exampleCN: 后半部分点明座位本身。

items.meaning: a seat, especially a teacher's chair
items.example: A teacher spoke from a kathedra.
The bishop's cathedra stood behind the altar.
items.exampleCN: 主教的宝座立在祭坛之后。

items.structure: cathedralis (church Latin adjective) used as a noun
items.meaning: the church containing the bishop's chair
items.example: The cathedral was rebuilt after the fire.
items.exampleCN: 大火之后，这座主教座堂被重建。

items.meaningCN: 以正式而不容置疑的权威
items.example: He spoke ex cathedra on the budget.
items.exampleCN: 他就预算问题以权威口吻发话。

items.meaning: a city that has a cathedral
items.example: The railway bypassed the cathedral city.
items.exampleCN: 铁路绕过了这座有主教座堂的城市。

items.meaning: the choir attached to a cathedral
items.meaningCN: 附属于主教座堂的唱诗班
items.example: The cathedral choir sings evensong daily.
items.exampleCN: 座堂唱诗班每天唱晚祷。

latinEntries.structure: cathedra, cathedrae (f., first declension; from Greek)

definition_zh: 均衡价格；供需数量相等时的市场成交价
definition_en: the price at which the quantity sellers offer equals the quantity buyers want
core_image: 两条曲线在黑板上相交，交点旁边挂着一个价签
scene: 小麦市场报告用一张图说明价格停在哪一档时，买卖双方报出的数量正好相符。 The wheat report used a chart to identify the equilibrium price at which offers and orders matched.
sceneCN: 小麦市场报告用一张图说明价格停在哪一档时买卖数量正好相符；句中的 equilibrium price 指「供需数量相等时的成交价格」（第 1 个义项：使供给量与需求量相等的价格）。图中可辨识物件：相交的两条曲线、交点处的价签、麦穗图标、报告纸页。

pos.zh: 均衡价格的（作定语，如 equilibrium-price analysis）

senses.title: The price where the two quantities match
senses.titleCN: 使供给量与需求量相等的那一档价格
senses.definition: the price at which the amount sellers offer is exactly the amount buyers want
senses.definitionCN: 卖方愿意提供的数量与买方想要的数量恰好相等的价格
senses.example: The wheat report used a chart to identify the equilibrium price at which offers and orders matched.
senses.exampleCN: 小麦市场报告用一张图找出买卖数量相符的均衡价格。
senses.why: Equilibrium means a level beam, and price is the value on that beam, so the phrase names the value at which the market stops tipping.
senses.whyCN: equilibrium 指放平的横梁，price 是横梁上的数值，因此这个短语指市场不再倾斜时的价位。

senses.title: The market-clearing price
senses.definition: the price at which everything offered is sold and every order is filled
senses.definitionCN: 供给全部售出、订单全部得到满足的价格
senses.example: At the market-clearing price, no crate of grain is left unsold.
senses.exampleCN: 在市场出清价上，没有一箱粮食剩下卖不掉。
senses.why: Clearing is what balance looks like in a market: nothing left on one side, nothing waiting on the other.
senses.whyCN: 「出清」就是平衡在市场里的样子：一边不剩货，另一边也不留空等。

senses.title: The vertical coordinate of the crossing
senses.definition: the price value read off the vertical axis where the two curves cross
senses.definitionCN: 两条曲线相交处，在纵轴上读出的价格数值
senses.example: Read the equilibrium price from the vertical axis, not the horizontal one.
senses.exampleCN: 均衡价格要从纵轴读出，而不是横轴。
senses.why: Once the relation is drawn, price becomes one coordinate of a single point, so the phrase names that coordinate.
senses.whyCN: 关系一旦画成图，价格就成了一个点的坐标之一，这个短语便指那个坐标。

senses.title: A benchmark for policy
senses.definition: the price used as a comparison when a tax, subsidy or price cap is proposed
senses.definitionCN: 提出税收、补贴或限价时用来作比较的价格
senses.example: The subsidy moved the traded price away from the equilibrium price.
senses.exampleCN: 补贴使实际成交价偏离了均衡价格。
senses.why: A benchmark is a level one measures deviation from, and a balance point is the natural zero for such comparisons.
senses.whyCN: 基准就是用来衡量偏离的参照，而平衡点正是这类比较的天然零点。

senses.title: A price that moves after a shock
senses.titleCN: 冲击之后形成的新均衡价
senses.definition: the new price at which the market settles after supply or demand changes
senses.definitionCN: 供给或需求变化后市场重新稳定下来的价格
senses.example: A poor harvest produced a much higher equilibrium price.
senses.exampleCN: 歉收造成了高得多的均衡价格。
senses.why: The beam still finds a level, but with different weights, so the phrase follows the market to its new resting point.
senses.whyCN: 横梁仍会找到水平，只是重量变了，因此这个短语跟着市场走到新的静止点。

senses.title: The price that removes shortage and surplus
senses.titleCN: 消除短缺与过剩的价格
senses.definition: the price at which neither a shortage nor a surplus remains
senses.definitionCN: 既不留下短缺也不留下过剩的价格
senses.example: Below the equilibrium price, a shortage appears; above it, a surplus does.
senses.exampleCN: 低于均衡价格会出现短缺，高于它则出现过剩。
senses.why: Both imbalances are departures from one price, so naming that price names the cure for both.
senses.whyCN: 两种失衡都是对同一价位的偏离，因此指出这个价位就等于指出两者的解药。

senses.title: A theoretical benchmark, not a posted tag
senses.titleCN: 理论基准，而非货架上的标价
senses.definition: a modelled value used for reasoning, which need not equal any price actually charged
senses.definitionCN: 用于推理的模型数值，未必等于任何实际收取的价格
senses.example: Textbook models treat the equilibrium price as a benchmark rather than a shop label.
senses.exampleCN: 教科书模型把均衡价格当作基准，而不是商店标签。
senses.why: A model can solve for a level that no single transaction reaches, so the term marks an ideal rather than a fact.
senses.whyCN: 模型可以解出一个没有任何单笔交易达到的水平，因此这个术语标记的是理想值而非事实。

senses.title: The attributive form in analysis
senses.definition: used before a noun to name a study or estimate built on the balancing price
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，指以这一平衡价格为基础的研究或估算
senses.example: The equilibrium-price study estimated costs for the coming season.
senses.exampleCN: 这份均衡价格研究估算了下一季的成本。
senses.why: Hyphenated, the phrase stops naming a price and starts naming the method that computes it.
senses.whyCN: 加连字符后，这个短语不再指某个价格，而指计算它的方法。

intro.en: Equilibrium price joins a Latin-derived balance word with an Old French price word; the combination itself is a nineteenth-century economics term.
intro.cn: equilibrium price 把拉丁来源的「平衡」词与古法语来源的「价格」词组合起来，这一组合本身是十九世纪经济学的术语。

items.en: Pretium meant 'price, value, reward'. Its deeper origin is not established, so any earlier form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: pretium 意为「价格、价值、报酬」。其更深来源未得到证明，凡为其给出的更早形式都属重构。

items.en: Old French pris, 'price, value', carried the word into Middle English in the thirteenth century.
items.cn: 古法语 pris「价格、价值」在十三世纪把这个词带入中古英语。

items.en: By the sixteenth century price covered both the money asked and the worth of a thing.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，price 既指所要的钱，也指一物的价值。

items.en: Aequilibrium, 'level balance', supplied the first half, built on aequus 'level' and libra 'scales'.
items.cn: 前半来自 aequilibrium「水平的平衡」，由 aequus「平」与 libra「天平」构成。

items.en: Classical economists paired the two words for the price that clears a market, and Marshall's 1890 textbook fixed the term.
items.cn: 古典经济学家把这两个词配在一起，指使市场出清的价格，马歇尔 1890 年的教科书固定了这一术语。

items.en: Source uncertain: the deeper origin of pretium is unsettled and the first use of the full phrase is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 来源不确定：pretium 的更深来源尚无定论，整个短语的最早用例也只能给约数。

note.en: Group one holds neighbouring price terms easily mistaken for this one; group two holds near labels for the same balancing value.
note.cn: 第一组是容易被当成均衡价格的相邻价格术语；第二组是同一平衡价位的近义说法。

entries.definition: The price at which goods are actually trading now; it may sit above or below the balancing level.
entries.definitionCN: 货物当下实际成交的价格；可能高于或低于平衡价位。

entries.definition: The amount traded at the balancing level; it is the horizontal partner of this price.
entries.definitionCN: 平衡价位上成交的数量；是这个价格在横轴上的伙伴。

entries.definition: What a seller hopes to get, set before any bargaining; it has no balancing role.
entries.definitionCN: 卖方希望得到的价码，在议价前定下；不含平衡作用。

entries.definition: A price fixed by a government or a firm rather than by the meeting of offers and orders.
entries.definitionCN: 由政府或企业定下的价格，而非由供需相遇形成。

entries.definition: The same value seen as the price that empties the market; it stresses the clearing rather than the balance.
entries.definitionCN: 同一价位的另一视角：使市场出清的价格；强调出清而非平衡。

entries.definition: A shortened label used in auctions and exchanges for the price that matches all bids and offers.
entries.definitionCN: 拍卖与交易所使用的简称，指使所有出价与报价相符的价格。

entries.definition: A price judged morally acceptable; fairness is a judgement, while equilibrium is a modelled outcome.
entries.definitionCN: 被认为道德上可接受的价格；公平是判断，均衡是模型结果。

entries.definition: A chosen selling level in a product range; it is a decision, not a computed balance.
entries.definitionCN: 产品系列中选定的售价档位；是决策，不是算出的平衡。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two source words, their fixed phrases and the diagram that shows them.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个来源词、它们的固定搭配，以及把它们画出来的图示。

normal.en: Balance plus price: the value at which the market stops tipping.
normal.cn: 平衡加价格：市场停止倾斜时的那个数值。

normal.en: The usual fixed phrases are above the equilibrium price and below the equilibrium price.
normal.cn: 常见固定说法是高于均衡价格与低于均衡价格。

normal.en: It is the vertical coordinate of the point where the two curves cross.
normal.cn: 它是两条曲线交点处的纵坐标。

normal.en: Its partner term is equilibrium quantity, the horizontal coordinate.
normal.cn: 与它配对的术语是均衡数量，即横坐标。

normal.en: Policy talk compares the traded price with this benchmark.
normal.cn: 政策讨论拿实际成交价与这个基准作比较。

abstract.en: Picture two curves crossing and a price tag hanging exactly at the crossing.
abstract.cn: 想象两条曲线相交，一个价签正好挂在交点处。

abstract.en: Picture a beam that stops moving only at one particular weight.
abstract.cn: 想象一根横梁，只在某一个特定重量上才停止摆动。

abstract.en: Picture a market where every crate lifted is matched by one order filled.
abstract.cn: 想象一个市场，每搬走一箱货，就正好有一张订单被填上。

examples.en: A tax on sellers raises the equilibrium price and lowers the quantity traded.
examples.cn: 对卖方征税会提高均衡价格，并减少成交量。

examples.en: The equilibrium price of the crop fell once two exporting countries reopened their ports.
examples.cn: 两个出口国重开港口后，这种作物的均衡价格下跌。

examples.en: Analysts disagree about where the equilibrium price really sits.
examples.cn: 分析人士对均衡价格究竟在哪一档意见不一。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「equilibrium（平衡）+ price（价格）」——天平放平那一刻对应的是哪个价

root: 由 equilibrium（拉丁 aequilibrium「水平的平衡」）与 price（拉丁 pretium「价格」，经古法语 pris）组合而成的经济学短语，自身无独立拉丁词源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one value: the matching price, the clearing price, the vertical coordinate, a policy benchmark, a new level after a shock, the cure for shortage and surplus, a modelled ideal and finally an attributive method label.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一个数值：相符的价格、出清价、纵坐标、政策基准、冲击后的新水平、消除短缺与过剩的价格、模型中的理想值，最后是作定语的方法标签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two curves meeting, with a price tag pinned at the meeting point.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条曲线相交，交点上钉着一个价签。

branches.en: MATCH AND CLEAR: the price that equates offers and orders is the same price that empties the market.
branches.cn: 相符与出清：使报价与订单相等的价格，也就是让市场不剩货的价格。

branches.en: COORDINATE: on a diagram the value shrinks to one number on the vertical axis.
branches.cn: 坐标：在图上这个值缩小为纵轴上的一个数字。

branches.en: BENCHMARK: policy measures deviation from it, and models treat it as an ideal rather than a tag.
branches.cn: 基准：政策衡量对它的偏离，模型则把它当作理想值而非标签。

branches.en: EQUILIBRATION: after a shock the beam finds a new level, and each level is the cure for shortage and surplus alike.
branches.cn: 再平衡：冲击之后横梁找到新水平，而每个水平都是短缺与过剩的共同解药。

branches.en: METHOD: hyphenated, the phrase names the analysis rather than the price.
branches.cn: 方法：加连字符后，短语指分析而非价格。

intro.en: The phrase is two words from two different Latin roots, so it is read as a balance word plus a value word.
intro.cn: 这个短语由两个来自不同拉丁词根的词组成，要按「平衡」加「价值」来读。

latinIntro.en: Aequus and libra supply the first word, pretium the second; none of the three belongs to the phrase as a whole.
latinIntro.cn: aequus 与 libra 构成第一个词，pretium 构成第二个词；三者都不专属于整个短语。

items.example: The prefix carries the evenness of the balance.
items.exampleCN: 这个构词成分带着平衡的均平感。

items.example: The root supplies the weighing image.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供称量的意象。

items.example: The second word comes from this root.

items.meaning: the money asked for a thing
items.example: The price settled at the crossing.
The market found equilibrium.
Pricing decisions follow the model.
items.exampleCN: 定价决策依据这个模型。

items.example: Overpriced stock stayed on the shelf.
items.exampleCN: 定价过高的货留在架上。

items.example: Underpriced tickets sold out at once.
items.exampleCN: 定价过低的票立刻售罄。

items.meaning: setting prices by the balancing level
items.example: The firm adopted equilibrium pricing.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司采用均衡定价。

definition_zh: 围绕订婚、婚礼与婚后生活形成的传统做法与规矩
definition_en: the traditional practices and rules that surround engagement, wedding ceremonies and the start of married life
core_image: 喜堂门口摆着两双新鞋，桌上一盘红枣与花生，来客按辈分依次拱手
scene: 喜堂的门口摆着两双新鞋，桌上放着一盘红枣和花生，来客按辈分依次行礼。 Village marriage customs require the bride to circle the fire three times.
sceneCN: 这里 marriage customs 指「围绕婚事形成的传统做法与规矩」（第 1 个义项：一整套在婚礼前后被遵循的习俗）；句意为村里的婚姻习俗要求新娘绕火三圈。可辨识物件：新鞋、红枣、花生、喜堂、火盆。

pos.zh: 婚姻习俗（复数名词短语）

senses.title: Traditional practices around a wedding
senses.titleCN: 婚礼前后遵循的传统做法
senses.definition: the expected actions and taboos that a community follows when a couple marry
senses.definitionCN: 一个社群在两人成婚时所遵循的既定行为与禁忌
senses.example: Village marriage customs require the bride to circle the fire three times.
senses.exampleCN: 村里的婚姻习俗要求新娘绕火三圈。
senses.why: custom is habitual practice, and marriage is the occasion where practice is most tightly scripted.
senses.whyCN: custom 指习惯性做法，而婚姻正是这种做法被规定得最细的场合。

senses.title: Practices of betrothal
senses.definition: the steps of proposing, negotiating and formally promising a future marriage
senses.definitionCN: 提亲、商谈并正式许诺未来婚事的各个步骤
senses.example: Betrothal customs in that region begin with a gift of tea.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区的订婚习俗以送茶开始。
senses.why: the wedding is the visible end, so most of the customs begin earlier and quietly.
senses.whyCN: 婚礼是看得见的终点，因此许多习俗更早、更安静地开始。

senses.title: Exchange of bride price and dowry
senses.definition: the transfer of goods or money between the families of the bride and groom
senses.definitionCN: 新娘与新郞两家之间转移财物或金钱
senses.example: Marriage customs once fixed the amount of the bride price.
senses.exampleCN: 婚姻习俗曾规定聘礼的数额。
senses.why: a marriage joins two households as well as two people, and goods mark that join.
senses.whyCN: 婚姻既连接两个人，也连接两户人家，财物正是这一连接的标记。

senses.title: Symbolic acts in the ceremony
senses.titleCN: 婚礼仪式中的象征行为
senses.definition: gestures such as exchanging rings, veiling the bride or circling a fire that carry meaning beyond the literal act
senses.definitionCN: 交换戒指、为新娘盖头、绕火等带有字面之外含义的动作
senses.example: The rings are only one of many symbolic marriage customs.
senses.exampleCN: 戒指只是众多象征性婚姻习俗之一。
senses.why: customs work by symbol: a small act stands for a large promise.
senses.whyCN: 习俗靠象征运作：一个小动作代表一个大承诺。

senses.title: Rules about where the couple lives
senses.definition: the expectation that a new couple lives with the groom's or the bride's family
senses.definitionCN: 新婚夫妇随夫家或随妻家居住的期待
senses.example: Marriage customs in the valley favour living near the husband's parents.
senses.exampleCN: 山谷里的婚姻习俗偏向住在丈夫父母附近。
senses.why: residence decides which household gains a worker, so it is a rule, not a detail.
senses.whyCN: 居住地决定哪一户多得一个劳动力，因此它是规则而非细节。

senses.title: Marriage taboos and prohibitions
senses.titleCN: 与婚姻相关的禁忌与禁例
senses.definition: rules forbidding certain partners, dates or actions as dangerous or impure
senses.definitionCN: 因危险或不洁而禁止某些配偶、日期或行为的规则
senses.example: Customs forbade marriage between people sharing a surname.
senses.exampleCN: 习俗禁止同姓者通婚。
senses.why: every custom has a fence, and marriage customs fence off who may marry whom.
senses.whyCN: 每种习俗都有围栏，而婚姻习俗围住的是谁可以与谁成婚。

senses.title: Comparison across cultures
senses.titleCN: 不同文化婚姻习俗的比较
senses.definition: the scholarly description and comparison of wedding practices in different societies
senses.definitionCN: 对不同社会中婚礼做法的学术描述与比较
senses.example: The course compares marriage customs from six regions.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程比较六个地区的婚姻习俗。
senses.why: once practices are written down, they become objects that can be set side by side.
senses.whyCN: 做法一旦被记录下来，就成了可以并排放置的对象。

senses.title: Simplification and revival today
senses.titleCN: 当代的简化与传统习俗的复兴
senses.definition: the modern trimming of elaborate rites and the deliberate return to older forms
senses.definitionCN: 现代对繁复礼仪的删减，以及有意回归旧形式
senses.example: Young couples now mix civil marriage customs with a traditional tea rite.
senses.exampleCN: 年轻夫妻如今把民事婚姻习俗与传统敬茶礼混在一起。
senses.why: customs survive by being edited, not by being frozen.
senses.whyCN: 习俗靠被改写而存活，而非靠被冻结。

intro.en: Marriage customs joins marriage, from Latin maritus 'husband' through Old French, with custom, from Latin consuetudo 'habit, usage' through Old French costume. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: marriage customs 由 marriage 与 custom 合成：marriage 经古法语来自拉丁 maritus「丈夫」，custom 经古法语 costume 来自拉丁 consuetudo「习惯、惯例」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Maritus meant 'husband', and maritare 'to wed' produced Old French mariage and English marriage. The deeper origin of maritus is uncertain, and the link to mas 'male' is only a hypothesis.
items.cn: maritus 意为「丈夫」，动词 maritare「使成婚」衍生出古法语 mariage 与英语 marriage。maritus 的更深来源不确定，与 mas「男性」的联系仅是假说。

items.en: Consuetudo meant 'habit, custom, usage', built on consuescere 'to accustom', itself con- 'thoroughly' plus suescere 'to become used'.
items.cn: consuetudo 意为「习惯、风俗、惯例」，由 consuescere「使习惯」构成，而后者是 con-「彻底」加 suescere「变得习惯」。

items.en: Old French costume carried both 'habit' and 'usual practice' into English, where custom kept the social sense.
items.cn: 古法语 costume 把「习惯」与「惯常做法」带入英语，custom 保留了社会性含义。

items.en: English joined the two nouns to name the rules that surround a wedding, usually in the plural because a wedding is a sequence of acts.
items.cn: 英语把这两个名词组合起来，指围绕婚礼的规矩；因婚礼是一连串动作，通常用复数。

items.en: Comparative anthropology made marriage customs a standard category for describing how societies arrange unions.
items.cn: 比较人类学使 marriage customs 成为描述各社会如何安排婚姻的标准类别。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the plural phrase is recorded only from modern field reports, and no single first use is fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个复数短语只见于近代田野报告，没有确切的最早书证。

note.en: Group one holds words built from the same two stems; group two holds terms for rules and rites that are often confused with custom.
note.cn: 第一组是同出这两个词干的词；第二组是常与 custom 混淆的规则与仪式类词。

entries.definition: A habitual practice of a group; marriage customs are the practices attached to one occasion.
entries.definitionCN: 指群体的习惯性做法；婚姻习俗则是附着于某一场合的做法。

entries.definition: Means 'according to custom'; it describes a practice, while the noun names it.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「按习俗的」；它描述做法，名词则指做法本身。

entries.definition: From the same Old French word in the sense of habitual use: one who comes habitually to a shop.
entries.definitionCN: 来自同一古法语词的「惯常使用」义：习惯性来店里的人。

entries.definition: The same Old French word that gave custom, now meaning dress; the two meanings split in English.
entries.definitionCN: 与 custom 同出一个古法语词，今指服装；两个含义在英语中分化。

entries.definition: A prescribed religious or solemn act; customs may include rites but are broader and less formal.
entries.definitionCN: 指规定的宗教或庄严行为；习俗可包含仪式，但范围更广、更不正式。

entries.definition: Anything passed from generation to generation; custom stresses repeated practice rather than age alone.
entries.definitionCN: 指代代相传的一切；custom 强调反复实践，而不只是年代久远。

entries.definition: A rule accepted by agreement, often recent; custom is older and unwritten.
entries.definitionCN: 指经同意而被接受的规则，往往较新；custom 更古老且不成文。

entries.definition: A rule enforced by a state; a custom may be written into law, but it begins without that force.
entries.definitionCN: 指由国家强制执行的规则；习俗可被写入法律，但它起初并无这种强制力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real word partnerships and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: marriage comes from maritus 'husband'; custom comes from consuetudo 'habit'.
normal.cn: marriage 来自 maritus「丈夫」；custom 来自 consuetudo「习惯」。

normal.en: The plural is normal because a wedding is a chain of small acts, not one act.
normal.cn: 用复数很正常，因为婚礼是一连串小动作，而非单个动作。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: local marriage customs, traditional marriage customs, observe marriage customs.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：地方婚姻习俗、传统婚姻习俗、遵守婚姻习俗。

normal.en: The family runs custom, customary, customer and customize, though their meanings have drifted apart.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 custom、customary、customer 与 customize，但词义已经分化。

normal.en: Anthropology treats the phrase as a category for comparison, not as advice for couples.
normal.cn: 人类学把这个短语当作比较类别，而非给新人的建议。

abstract.en: Picture a script passed down for a wedding nobody remembers writing.
abstract.cn: 想象一场婚礼的脚本代代相传，却没人记得是谁写的。

abstract.en: Picture two families exchanging goods as a sentence exchanges subjects.
abstract.cn: 想象两户人家交换财物，就像句子交换主语。

abstract.en: Picture a fence built from habits rather than from wood.
abstract.cn: 想象一道用习惯而非木头筑成的围栏。

examples.en: The museum collected photographs of marriage customs from fifty villages.
examples.cn: 博物馆收集了五十个村庄的婚姻习俗照片。

examples.en: Migration changed marriage customs faster than law did.
examples.cn: 迁徙改变婚姻习俗的速度快于法律。

examples.en: Some marriage customs survive mainly as performance for visitors.
examples.cn: 有些婚姻习俗如今主要作为给游客看的表演而存在。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「marriage（婚姻）+ customs（习俗）」——办喜事时一套套的老规矩

root: marriage 来自拉丁 maritus「丈夫」经古法语 mariage；custom 来自拉丁 consuetudo「习惯、惯例」经古法语 costume。maritus 的更深来源不确定，与 mas「男性」的联系仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one script: a community writes down how a marriage should be made, and that script covers betrothal, goods, symbols, residence, taboos, comparison and modern revision.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一套脚本展开：一个社群写下婚事应当如何办，这套脚本涵盖订婚、财物、象征、居住、禁忌、比较与现代改写。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wedding script written in gestures rather than words, performed in the same order each time.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份用动作而非文字写成的婚礼脚本，每次按同样顺序演出。

branches.en: THE WHOLE SCRIPT: the phrase names the full set of expected actions before any single one.
branches.cn: 整套脚本：这个短语先指全部被期待的动作，再指其中任何一项。

branches.en: BEFORE AND ACROSS: betrothal is the quiet opening, and comparison turns the script into an object of study.
branches.cn: 之前与横比：订婚是安静的开端，比较则把脚本变成研究对象。

branches.en: GOODS THAT BIND: the transfer of wealth is a sentence spoken in objects.
branches.cn: 以物相系：财物的转移是用物件说出的句子。

branches.en: SIGNS AND FENCES: symbolic acts say what is promised, and taboos say what is forbidden.
branches.cn: 符号与围栏：象征动作说出承诺，禁忌说出禁止。

branches.en: WHERE AND WHETHER: residence decides who gains a worker, and revival decides which parts still speak.
branches.cn: 住在哪与是否延续：居住决定谁多得劳力，复兴决定哪些部分仍有话说。

intro.en: The phrase combines a Latin-derived noun of marriage with a Latin-derived noun of habit, and both stems carry their own suffixes into English.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个源自拉丁的婚姻名词与一个源自拉丁的习惯名词组合起来，两个词干都带着各自的后缀进入英语。

latinIntro.en: Latin maritus and consuetudo stand behind the two halves; -age turns the wedding act into a state, while the custom family loses its Latin ending in French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 maritus 与 consuetudo 分别是两半的来源；-age 把成婚之举变成状态，而 custom 一族在法语中丢掉了拉丁词尾。

items.example: The first half of the phrase begins with the husband.
items.exampleCN: 短语的前一半从丈夫说起。

items.example: The verb supplied the French noun of marriage.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供了法语的婚姻名词。

items.example: The suffix makes a state out of an act.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把行为变成状态。

items.example: Marriage names what the customs surround.
items.exampleCN: marriage 指习俗所围绕的那件事。

items.example: Consuetudo is the source of the second half.
items.exampleCN: consuetudo 是短语后一半的来源。

items.example: A custom is what a group has grown used to.
items.exampleCN: 习俗就是一个群体逐渐习惯的东西。

items.example: Old French costume meant practice before it meant dress.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 costume 先指做法，后指服装。

items.example: Custom kept the social sense and lost the clothing sense.
items.exampleCN: custom 保留了社会义，丢掉了服装义。

items.example: Customary acts are the ones the phrase collects.
items.exampleCN: 按习俗的行为正是这个短语所汇集的对象。

items.structure: custom + -er, from the sense of habitual use
items.example: A customer was once simply a person wont to come.
items.exampleCN: 顾客原只是习惯于常来的人。
